- DO-3 §2.4 (`unit-plan-job.ts`), §6 (`unit_plan`), §7 (`DRAFT_OUTPUT_TOKEN_CAP`)
- CON-8 (agreed: one UnitPlan per run, stored before any lesson job starts, 47 entries on the issued unit, links computed by code), CON-5 (plan failure → run `paused` with `paused_reason.check unit_plan`), CON-7 (Resume retries); PRD R-8; HP-1; SP-1 (`UnitPlan` keeps schema-enforced output, cost $0.16)
- WP-1 (`docs/data/worked-pairs.md`: the plan entry for row 8); DO-6 WF-21; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`unit-plan-job.ts` NL-31)
- **Brief check:** serves "a plan of the unit before lessons" (R-8); touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

- [ ] AC-9 [capture] Component records for WF-21 against the stub: one `unit_plan` row with 47 entries, its `model_call` with rendered prompt and raw output, stored before the first lesson claim, `run_id` on both (WF-21; the real-wiring `test_unit_plan_capture` is NL-79's) — verify: `npx vitest run apps/worker/src/generation/unit-plan.capture.test.ts` — evidence: pass; rows printed — covers: OBS-1, OBS-2, OBS-5, M-15, M-29
- [ ] AC-10 [regression/context] area map rows for this ticket's paths planned → actual (A9 rows: `unit-plan-job.ts`); router and ICM rows if a route's evidence changed; one dev-log entry (Changed · Why · Checked · Remaining) — verify: `git diff --stat` and `python3 ~/.claude/skills/icm-project/scripts/check_context.py .` — evidence: diff touches only those rows; no FAIL — covers: — (component of a larger flow; the integrating ticket proves the requirement)

### What to build
**Modules (DO-3 §2.1):** `packages/llm/src/{model-client,anthropic,stub,prices}.ts`.
- `model-client.ts`: re-exports the `ModelClient`, `StructuredCallRequest`, `PromptBlock`, `ModelResponse` types and the `ModelAlias` literal from `@ls/core/ports/model-client` (NL-12 wrote them; DO-4 §13 R-19), replaces NL-14's local structural `PromptBlock` in `packages/prompts/src/inputs.ts` with `import type { PromptBlock } from "@ls/core/ports/model-client"` (same area A7; the one edit in `packages/prompts`), and `model_id_for(alias, settings)` mapping `GENERATION|REPAIR|ASSIST` to `MODEL_GENERATION_ID|MODEL_REPAIR_ID|MODEL_ASSIST_ID` (default `claude-sonnet-5-5`). No logic beyond that.
- `anthropic.ts`: `AnthropicMessagesAdapter implements ModelClient` from `AnthropicMessagesAdapter_ctor{api_key: SecretStr, model_ids, http_timeout_ms}`. **The only file in the repository that imports `@anthropic-ai/sdk`** (NL-01's boundaries lint enforces it). `complete(req)` makes exactly one Messages API request: `system_blocks` become the `system` array with `cache_control` on the last block whose `cacheable` is true (GP-33); `user_blocks` the single user message; `max_output_tokens` → `max_tokens`; `effort` is passed to the SDK's effort setting only when non-null; `temperature` only when non-null (SP-1 ran with the provider default); the per-request timeout is `req.timeout_ms`. `output_mode "schema_enforced"` sends `output_json_schema` through the SDK's structured-output option (UnitPlan, assist, judge); `"prompt_embedded"` sends no schema parameter, because the renderer already placed the schema in a `schema` system block (LessonDraft and repair, SP-1: the API's enforced mode rejected `LessonDraft`). The response is mapped to `ModelResponse`: `raw_text` = the concatenated text blocks verbatim, `stop_reason` mapped to the five-value literal (an API refusal stays a `stop_reason "refusal"`, not an exception), `usage` with all four token counts (cache read and write included), `requested_model` from the request, **`served_model` from the response body**, `provider_request_id` from the `request-id` header, `latency_ms`. Errors become `ProviderError{kind, retryable, http_status, retry_after_s, provider_request_id}`: 429→`rate_limited` (reads `retry-after`), 529→`overloaded`, other 5xx→`server_error`, abort→`timeout`, socket failure→`connection`, 400/422→`bad_request`, 401/403→`auth`. The adapter never retries (the recorder owns retries) and never writes a log line containing the key, a prompt or an output; the error `message` is the HTTP status text only.
- `stub.ts`: `StubModelClient implements ModelClient` — deterministic, no network. Scripted per `(alias, purpose)` queue or a function; can return text, `stop_reason "max_tokens"`, a `ProviderError` (429 with `retry_after_s`, 529, timeout), or wait on `FakeClock` for a given delay; usage is computed from text length (`ceil(chars/4)`) so costs are non-zero and repeatable; `served_model "stub-model"`; records every request (`calls`) and offers an `on_enter` hook so a test can assert state while the call is "in flight". `StubJudgeClient implements JudgeClient` (cut #2) returns scripted `yes|no` verdicts the same way.
- `prices.ts`: `PRICE_TABLE: PriceTable` with `confirmed_on "2026-10-25"` and one `ModelPrice` — `claude-sonnet-5-5`: input 2.00, output 10.00, cache read 0.20, cache write 2.50 (USD per million tokens, `Decimal`; SP-1 and the provider docs, PD-12); `price_for(model_id)` throws `InvariantViolation("no price for <model>")` for an unknown model so an unpriced call can never be settled at zero.
Must not: import the SDK anywhere else; log or return the key (the `SecretStr` prints as `[redacted]`); retry; read a prompt or output into any log; touch spend or model_call rows; make a live network call in any test (an optional live smoke call, if wanted, is a separate `gate::paid` action under PD-29 and not part of this ticket's evidence).

### Story
US-32 — As a content lead (P-3), I need one trace per run whose totals equal the sums over the stored calls, with cost taken from the provider's usage fields, so that I can trust what the batch cost. This ticket makes sure no call is ever invisible: the row exists before the send, the raw answer is saved the moment it arrives, and lost calls are counted.

### What to build
**Modules:** `packages/llm/src/recorder.ts` (`ModelCallRecorder`), `packages/llm/src/paid-call.ts` (`PaidCaller`, Metz S6) and `packages/db/src/repos/model-calls.ts` (`PgModelCallLog implements ModelCallLog`, table `model_call`, NL-08 `0005_traces.sql`). Interfaces exactly as DO-4 §3.4 and §4. Two same-wave collaborators are injected as typed-from-DO-4 objects and tested with doubles: the cost functions `settle_cost` and `max_call_cost` (NL-35 owns `packages/core/src/spend/reservation.ts`) arrive as the constructor parameter `cost: CostMath{settle_cost, max_call_cost}` on both `ModelCallRecorder` and `PaidCaller` (DO-4 §4, §13 R-6; the wiring in NL-79/NL-116 passes NL-35's functions), and the `SpendLedger` is the port from NL-12.
- **`ModelCallRecorder.call(ctx, req, rendered)` → `RecordedCall`.** (1) `log.insert_sent(ModelCallStart{…, rendered_prompt = rendered.text, requested_model, reservation_id})` **before** the send; (2) `client.complete(req)` with retries on `ProviderError` kinds `rate_limited`, `overloaded`, `server_error` and `connection` — at most `PROVIDER_MAX_RETRIES` (3), the delay is `retry_after_s` when the provider gave one, else `1 s × 2^n` with ±20 % jitter, always `clock.sleep` (a `timeout` is **not** retried: a retry could pay for a call the provider already ran; DO-4 §10.2 `ProviderError.retryable`, §13 R-22), the same `model_call` row for every attempt, `retries` counted; the hard per-call timeout is `req.timeout_ms` (`MODEL_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS` 240000, SP-1); (3) on success `log.complete(id, ModelCallCompletion{raw_output, stop_reason, usage, cost_usd = cost.settle_cost(prices.price_for(served_model), usage), served_model, provider_request_id, latency_ms})` **the moment the response arrives, before any parsing**; on final failure `log.fail(id, ProviderErrorRecord)` and re-raise the `ProviderError`. It never retries a truncation or a schema failure (the callers decide). `checkpoint(job_id, purpose, attempt)` = `log.completed_for`; `attempt` is the call's own ordinal for `(job, purpose)`, never `ClaimedJob.attempt` (G-19). One `model_call` JSON log line per call end (`service, build_id, request_id, run_id, lesson_id, job_id, model_call_id, purpose, alias, served_model, token counts, cost_usd, latency_ms, retries, status`) — never the prompt, the output or a key.
- **`PaidCaller.call(p)` → `RecordedCall`** (the only reserve → call → settle | release protocol): `amount = cost.max_call_cost(prices.price_for(recorder model for req.alias), rendered.input_tokens_estimate, req.max_output_tokens)`; `spend.reserve({run_id, job_id, user_id, purpose, amount_usd})`; a refusal raises `SpendRefused(refused_by, scope, amount)` with **no `model_call` row and nothing sent**; allowed → `recorder.call` with `ctx.reservation_id`; then `spend.settle(reservation_id, recorded.cost_usd, model_call_id)`; in `finally`, `spend.release(reservation_id)` (a no-op once settled, so a thrown error or abort always frees the reservation). Every call reserves its own worst case right before it is sent (draft 32,000, truncation retry 48,000, repair 32,000 output tokens).
- **`PgModelCallLog`** from `PgRepo_ctor`: `insert_sent` (id `mc_…`, `status sent`, `sent_at`, `attempt`, `reservation_id`, `rendered_prompt`, `request_id`, `experiment_id`), `complete` (`status completed` plus the fields), `fail` (`status failed`; the error is stored as `stop_reason = "error:<kind>[:<http_status>]"`, no message text), `mark_lost(job_id)` (every `sent` row of the job → `lost`; returns the count; called by `ClaimLoop.start`), `completed_for(job_id, purpose, attempt)` (a `completed` row with `raw_output`, never re-sent), `totals_for_run(run_id)` → `RunCallTotals{calls, completed, failed, lost, retries, truncation_retries (rows with purpose truncation_retry), repairs (purpose repair), cost_usd (sum over completed), input_tokens, output_tokens}`. The per-call count is stored in `model_call.retries` (int, default 0), now in DO-3 §6's column list for NL-08's `0005_traces.sql` (DO-4 §13 R-16).
Must not: send before the row exists; parse or validate model output; log prompt text, raw output or a key; import the Anthropic SDK; retry timeouts or truncations; edit `anthropic.ts`/`stub.ts`/`prices.ts` (NL-32), `repos/spend.ts` or `reservation.ts` (NL-35), DDL.

- [ ] AC-5 [failure/refusal] A `timeout` error (240 s `FakeClock`) is not retried: one attempt, row `failed` with `error:timeout`, `ProviderError(kind timeout)` raised; a `connection` error is retried like 5xx; truncation (`stop_reason max_tokens`) and schema problems are returned to the caller untouched, never retried — verify: `npx vitest run packages/llm/src/recorder.test.ts -t timeout_and_truncation_not_retried` — evidence: 3 cases; attempt counts — covers: R-16, CON-6

- [ ] AC-8 [invariant] `mark_lost(job_id)` turns every `sent` row of the job into `lost` (completed rows untouched) and returns the count; `totals_for_run` returns calls, completed, failed, lost, retries, truncation retries, repairs, input/output tokens and cost summed over completed rows only, and equals a hand-computed sum on a seeded run with one retry, one repair, one truncation retry and one lost call (WF-17) — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/model-calls.int.test.ts -t lost_and_totals` — evidence: totals object equals expected — covers: R-48, CON-21, M-15

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy

restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or

### Story
US-10 — As an outline author (P-2), I need to see the locked prompt layer (read-only) and every guidance version, and to start each run on exactly one of them, so that I know which instructions produced a lesson and nobody can edit the rules that keep the output safe. Saving guidance is a later ticket (NL-88, cut #7); this one makes the versions exist, list and pin.

### What to build
**1. Repository (`packages/db/src/repos/prompts.ts`, DO-4 §3.5).** `PgPromptRepo implements PromptRepo` from `PgRepo_ctor`; table `prompt_version` (NL-08 `0003_prompts.sql`). `current()` → the highest-numbered `PromptVersionRow`; `get(id)`; `all()` ordered by `number`; `pinned_by_runs(id)` → run ids from `run.prompt_version_id`; `insert_guidance(v, diff, tx)` (implemented now so NL-88 only adds the service path): locks the current row `FOR UPDATE`, refuses with `DomainRefusal(STALE_BASE, details.latest_version_id)` unless `v.base_version_id` is the current one, inserts `number+1` carrying the **same `locked_hash`** and the new `guidance_text`, `author_id`, `reason`, `diff`. Rows are immutable: the table has no update path in this repository, and a database trigger from NL-08 refuses UPDATE/DELETE.
Because DO-4's `PromptRepo` has no initializer, `PgPromptRepo` also has a repository-level (non-port) method `sync_locked_layer(locked_hash, tx)`: when the table is empty it inserts **v1** (`number 1`, `locked_hash`, empty `guidance_text`, `author_id null`, `reason "initial"`); when the current row's `locked_hash` differs from the files' hash it inserts a new version with the new hash and the current guidance carried over (so editing a locked file in a code change creates a new immutable version, never a mutation); when equal it does nothing. It is in DO-4 §3.5 `PgPromptRepo` (§13 R-6) and runs under `pg_advisory_xact_lock('prompt:sync')`, so two processes starting together insert v1 once.
**2. Service (`apps/web/src/server/services/prompt-service.ts`, DO-4 §5 `PromptService`).** Full DO-4 constructor `(prompts, audit, tx)`; `list(user)` (any signed-in role) → OpenAPI `PromptVersions{current_prompt_version_id, locked_layer{version_id, text}, guidance_versions[{version_id, number, author, created_at, reason, diff, pinned_by_runs}]}`: `locked_layer.text` is the locked files' text read through `packages/prompts` (NL-14), `locked_layer.version_id` is `locked-<first 12 hex of locked_hash>`, `author` is the author's name (`null` author → "system"), `pinned_by_runs` the run ids. `save_guidance` exists on the class and throws `NotBuiltYet("NL-88")`. The locked layer text is a response field only: no method accepts locked text.
**3. Route (`apps/web/app/api/prompt-versions/route.ts`)**: `GET` via `with_route` (any role, `listPromptVersions`). NL-88 adds the `POST` in the same file; this ticket exports no write handler and defines no `PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE`.
**4. Wiring (`apps/web/src/server/wiring/prompts.ts`, A0's stub; DO-4 `wire_prompts`)**: builds `PgPromptRepo`, `PgAuditLog`, `PromptService`; at construction calls `sync_locked_layer(locked_layer_hash(), tx)` once per process (NL-14's hash function; it is the same value as `RenderedPrompt.locked_hash`); returns `PromptWiring{prompts}`.
Must not: write the locked layer from any route or method; edit or delete a version; implement the guidance save (NL-88); re-implement the locked-layer hash; edit `container.ts`, DDL, `packages/prompts/**` (NL-14).

### Sources

## [NL-35] spend: reservation decision and atomic ledger (run cap, user-day cap, $75 build ceiling)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or

### Story
US-8 — As an outline author (P-2), I need a run to stop at its cap and never spend past it, even with six calls in flight, and the project to stop at the $75 build ceiling, so that no run, retry or AI suggestion can overspend. Money is decided in one pure function and written under one lock.

### What to build
**1. Pure math (`packages/core/src/spend/reservation.ts`, DO-4 §8 *spend*).** All money is `Decimal`; every result is rounded to 6 decimal places (`numeric(12,6)`).
- `max_call_cost(price, input_tokens_estimate, output_cap)` = `(input_tokens_estimate × max(input_per_mtok, cache_write_per_mtok) + output_cap × output_per_mtok) / 1,000,000`, rounded **up**. Example: 5,700 input, cap 32,000 at $2/$10 (cache write $2.50) → `0.014250 + 0.320000 = 0.334250`.
- `settle_cost(price, usage)` = `(input×input + output×output + cache_read×cache_read + cache_write×cache_write) / 1,000,000`, rounded half-up. Example: input 1,000, output 2,000, cache read 10,000 at $2/$10/$0.20 → `0.024000`; add 4,000 cache-write tokens at $2.50 → `0.034000`.
- `run_cap_for(cost_per_lesson, lessons, multiplier, unit_plan_cost)` = `cost_per_lesson × lessons × multiplier + unit_plan_cost` rounded **up** to the next whole dollar. Example: `0.182 × 47 × 1.5 + 0.16 = 12.991 → 13.00`. `user_day_cap_for(run_cap_default, multiplier)` = `13.00 × 2 = 26.00`.
- `decide_reservation(snapshot, amount_usd)`: caps are inclusive (`spent + reserved + amount ≤ cap`, CON-6); checked in the order `run_cap` (skipped when `run_cap_usd` is null, i.e. AI assist) → `day_cap` → `project_cap`; `refused_by` is the first that fails; `scope` is `user` for `day_cap`, `project` for `project_cap`, null for `run_cap`; `remaining_usd` is the headroom left on the refusing cap (never negative); `reservation_id` is always null (the ledger assigns it); the snapshot is returned unchanged. An `amount_usd ≤ 0` raises `InvariantViolation`.
**2. Ledger (`packages/db/src/repos/spend.ts`, DO-4 §3.4).** `PgSpendLedger implements SpendLedger` from `PgSpendLedger_ctor{db, ids, clock, settings: SpendSettings}` (project ceiling `BUILD_SPEND_CEILING_USD` 75, `USER_DAY_CAP_MULTIPLIER` 2, `RUN_CAP_DEFAULT_USD` 13.00; G-1, G-2). Table `spend_reservation` (NL-08 `0004_runs.sql`).
- `reserve(req)`: one transaction under `pg_advisory_xact_lock('spend')`: read the three sums — run (`settled + reserved` of this run's rows, cap from `run.cap_usd`), user-day (this user's rows whose `day` equals today's **UTC** date), project (every row's `settled_usd` + `reserved_usd` of rows still `reserved`, **plus** `model_call.cost_usd` of rows with `reservation_id` null, i.e. imported spike calls, G-5) — build the `SpendSnapshot`, call `decide_reservation`, and only if allowed `INSERT` one row (`id sr_…`, `status reserved`, `day`, `job_id`, `purpose`). A refusal writes nothing (shared guarantee 2).
- `settle(reservation_id, actual_usd, model_call_id)`: `reserved → settled` (or `released → settled`: a lost call that completed after `release_for_jobs` still records real spend); `settled_usd = actual`, `overshoot_usd = max(0, actual - reserved)` recorded, never refused, with a warning log line `spend.overshoot`; idempotent for the same `model_call_id`; `settled` is terminal. Returns `SettledReservation{released_usd = max(0, reserved - settled), overshoot_usd}`.
- `release(reservation_id)`: `reserved → released` (settled 0); a no-op returning the stored result on a settled or released row. `release_for_jobs(job_ids)`: every `reserved` row of those jobs → `released`; returns the count. `run_totals(run_id)` → `RunSpend{cap_usd, settled_usd, reserved_usd}`. `check_day_cap(user_id, amount_usd)`: dry run, writes nothing, `reservation_id` null, checks `day_cap` then `project_cap` (no run cap).
Must not: float arithmetic anywhere (a lint test greps `Number(`/`parseFloat` in the two files); write a row on refusal or on a dry run; call a model; edit `recorder.ts`/`paid-call.ts` (NL-33), `run-service.ts`, DDL.

### Sources
- DO-4 §3.4 (`ReservationRequest`, `SpendSnapshot`, `ReservationDecision`, `SpendReservationStatus`, `SpendReservationRow`, `SettledReservation`, `RunSpend`, `SpendLedger`, `PgSpendLedger`, `PgSpendLedger_ctor`); §2 `ModelPrice`, `TokenUsage`, `CapName`, `DayCapScope`; §8 *spend*; §10.2 `SpendRefused`
- DO-3 §2.1 (`spend/reservation.ts`), §2.2 (`repos/spend.ts`), §5 (*Spend math pure, ledger in SQL*), §6 (`spend_reservation`), §7 (`BUILD_SPEND_CEILING_USD`, `RUN_CAP_DEFAULT_USD`, `COST_PER_LESSON_ESTIMATE_USD`, `UNIT_PLAN_COST_ESTIMATE_USD`, `RUN_CAP_MULTIPLIER`, `USER_DAY_CAP_MULTIPLIER`)
- CON-5 (day cap = settled + reserved per user and per project, UTC day, `details.scope`/`remaining_usd`), CON-6 (`spent + reserved ≤ cap`, `capped_by` names), CON-16 and CON-17 (candidates and assist count against the day cap); PRD R-16, R-55, PD-14, PD-29; DO-1 D-8; SP-1 (cost per lesson $0.182, plan $0.16)
- Spec dry run T1 (`docs/design/spec-dry-run.md`, gaps G-1…G-10 now closed in DO-4); DO-5 S6; DO-7 M-17, M-29, M-44; DO-6 WF-22, WF-28; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`reservation.ts` + `spend.ts` NL-35)
- **Brief check:** serves "bound LLM spend" (R-16, R-55 and the $75 build ceiling); touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] Given `SpendSnapshot{run_cap_usd 10.00, run_settled 6.00, run_reserved 3.00}` with day and project far below their caps, when `decide_reservation(snapshot, 1.00)`, then `allowed true`, `refused_by null` (inclusive cap); with `1.000001` then `allowed false`, `refused_by "run_cap"`, `scope null`, `reservation_id null`, snapshot unchanged — verify: `npx vitest run packages/core/src/spend/reservation.test.ts -t run_cap_inclusive` — evidence: 2 passing cases — covers: R-16, CON-6

## [NL-36] collab: lesson document store transaction (Y.Doc + derived JSON + hash + state vector + `check_job`), v1 seeding, web-side `HttpCollabCommandClient`

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or

### Story
US-15 — As a reviewer (P-1), I need my edits stored durably together with the checks that follow them, and edits made from other screens (standards, slots, adopt, accept) to go through the same single writer, so that what I see, what is checked and what I later submit are one document. This ticket is the store transaction and the web side of the private call into the collaboration server.

### What to build
**1. Store (`packages/db/src/repos/lesson-docs.ts`, DO-4 §3.4).** `PgLessonDocStore implements LessonDocStore` from `PgLessonDocStore_ctor{db, ids, clock, checks: CheckQueue, states: LessonStateRepo, audit: AuditLog}`. It is the **only writer of `lesson_doc`** and writes no other table in its own SQL (Metz S2): the other tables are written through their ports.
- `store(req: StoreRequest) → StoreAck`: ONE transaction (HP-4): take `pg_advisory_xact_lock('lesson_doc:'||lesson_id)` → `INSERT lesson_doc` (`seq = max+1`, `store_id st_…`, `ydoc_bytes`, `derived_json`, `content_hash`, `state_vector`, `schema_version`, `stored_by`, `stored_at = clock.now()`, `request_id`) → `checks.enqueue(lesson_id, content_hash, store_id, tx)` → `states.record_last_editor(lesson_id, stored_by, tx)` when `stored_by` is set → `audit.append({action "lesson.store", target_kind "lesson", target_id lesson_id, version_hash content_hash, request_id, store_id, details {seq, tag}}, tx)`. Returns `StoreAck{…, check_job_enqueued true}`. Any failure rolls all four back; every durable store is one row (WF-9 asserts one `lesson_doc` row per store).
- `seed_initial(lesson_id, lesson, actor, tx) → SeedResult`: joins the **caller's** transaction (G-25): `lesson_to_ydoc(lesson)` (NL-19), `content_hash(lesson)`, `state_vector_of(bytes)`, then `INSERT … seq 1 ON CONFLICT (lesson_id, seq) DO NOTHING` (`seeded false`, `store_id null` on the conflict path) and, only when seeded, `checks.enqueue` in the same transaction. Writes no audit row (a system action; the version row carries provenance).
**2. Reader (`packages/db/src/repos/lesson-doc-reads.ts`).** `PgLessonDocReader implements LessonDocReader`: `latest(lesson_id) → StoredDoc | null` and `latest_derived(lesson_id) → DerivedRow | null` (highest `seq`; parses `derived_json` with the stored-lesson Zod schema and leaves `schema_version` for callers to check). Owned here (DO-3 §2.2 and §4 moved `lesson-doc-reads.ts` from A5 to this ticket; DO-4 §13 R-6).
**3. Client (`apps/web/src/server/adapters/collab-commands.ts`, DO-4 §3.3).** `HttpCollabCommandClient implements CollabCommands` from `HttpCollabCommandClient_ctor{base_url = COLLAB_INTERNAL_URL, token: SecretStr, timeout_ms 5000}`: `lock_and_snapshot(SubmitCommand) → SnapshotResult`, `apply_edit(EditCommand) → StoreAck`, `set_mode(ModeCommand) → ModeResult`, each `POST {base_url}/lessons/{encodeURIComponent(lesson_id)}/{lock-and-snapshot|apply-edit|set-mode}` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `X-Request-Id`, a JSON body, **no retry**. Results are parsed with Zod mirrors of the DO-4 records (dates revived). `collab_refusal_from(status, body, command, lesson_id, request_id)`: a non-2xx whose body parses as the OpenAPI `Error` envelope becomes `DomainRefusal` with the **same** `code`, `message` and `details` (so `NOT_STORED`, `BLOCKED` with `details.issues`, `LESSON_LOCKED` with `details.state`, `ANCHOR_CHANGED`, `SUGGESTION_PENDING`, `CONFIRMATION_OPEN` reach the browser unchanged), with `details.request_id` replaced by the web request's id and the collab request id logged as `collab_request_id`; a timeout (5 s), connection failure, a body that is not an envelope, or a 401 from the command route (a token mismatch: logged as `InvariantViolation`) becomes `CollabUnavailable{lesson_id, command}` → `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE`, with nothing changed. The token is never logged or put in an error.
Must not: write `lesson_doc` anywhere else; call a model; implement the collaboration server's command handlers (NL-105/NL-106) or socket auth (NL-80); retry a command; edit `repos/lessons.ts` (NL-42), `repos/check-queue.ts` (NL-37), `packages/ydoc/**` (NL-19), DDL.

### Sources
- DO-4 §3.3 (`SubmitCommand`, `SnapshotResult`, `EditCommand`, `StoreAck`, `ModeCommand`, `ModeResult`, `CollabCommands`, `HttpCollabCommandClient`, `collab_refusal_from`, `HttpCollabCommandClient_ctor`); §3.4 (`StoreRequest`, `StoredDoc`, `DerivedRow`, `SeedResult`, `LessonDocReader`, `LessonDocStore`, `PgLessonDocStore`, `PgLessonDocStore_ctor`); §8 *ydoc* (`lesson_to_ydoc`, `content_hash`, `state_vector_of`); §10.2 `CollabUnavailable`
- DO-3 §2.2 (`lesson-docs.ts`, `lesson-doc-reads.ts`), §2.3 (`collab-commands.ts`), §3 (`LessonDocStore`, `CollabCommands` seams: cut), §5 (*Lesson store transaction in one module*), §6 (`lesson_doc`, *One live document per lesson, many stores*), §7 (`COLLAB_INTERNAL_URL`, `COLLAB_INTERNAL_TOKEN`)
- CON-12 (agreed: each durable store writes Y.Doc bytes, derived JSON, hash, state vector and one coalesced `check_job` in one transaction; last editor includes AI accepts and adopt); INTERFACE shared guarantee 3 (content is written only through the collaboration server; `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` changes nothing) and guarantee 2; CON-11, CON-14, CON-15, CON-16, CON-18 (the callers); HP-4; SP-2 (store transaction p95 ≤ 500 ms)
- WP-1 (`docs/data/worked-pairs.md`: the v1 lesson that is seeded); DO-6 WF-9, WF-41, *Capture verification*; DO-5 S5; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`lesson-docs.ts` NL-36) and *Composition-root wiring owners*
- **Brief check:** serves "real-time collaborative editing with durable saves" (R-26, HP-4); touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

- [ ] AC-2 [failure/refusal] Atomicity: a forced failure in `checks.enqueue` (and separately in `audit.append`) leaves no `lesson_doc` row, no `check_job`, no last-editor change — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/lesson-docs.int.test.ts -t store_rolls_back_whole_unit` — evidence: 2 cases; counts 0 — covers: R-26, CON-G3
- [ ] AC-3 [invariant] Sequence safety: 8 concurrent `store` calls for one lesson give `seq` 1…8 with no gap or duplicate (advisory lock), and a store with `stored_by null` (system) does not change `last_editor_id` — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/lesson-docs.int.test.ts -t seq_unique_under_concurrency` — evidence: seq list 1..8 — covers: R-26, M-27

## [NL-37] checks: coalesced check queue and issue repository keyed to content hash

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or

### Story
US-16 — As a reviewer (P-1), I need the issue list to refresh after each save and to tell me when a newer save is still being checked, so that I know at once whether an edit broke a rule and never trust a stale list. This ticket is the queue that makes checks run once per stored hash and the table that keeps issues tied to the hash they were computed on.

### What to build
**Module:** `packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.ts` — `PgCheckQueue implements CheckQueue` and `PgIssueRepo implements IssueRepo` (DO-4 §3.4, §3.5), both from `PgRepo_ctor`; tables `check_job` (`0007_checks.sql`) and `issue` (NL-08). Runs at the check worker (NL-81), the store (NL-36), the issue service (NL-45) and Approve/Submit (NL-53, NL-106) use it.
**PgCheckQueue.**
- `enqueue(lesson_id, content_hash, store_id, tx)`: joins the caller's transaction; coalesced — at most one `queued` row per lesson (partial unique index): a newer hash **replaces** the queued row's `content_hash`/`store_id` (and `enqueued_at` stays the oldest), an already running row is left alone and a fresh queued row follows it; issues `NOTIFY check_job` after the surrounding commit.
- `claim(lease_ms)`: `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, oldest queued first, also reclaiming a `running` row whose `lease_until` has lapsed; sets `claimed_at`, `lease_until`; returns `ClaimedCheck{lesson_id, content_hash, store_id, lease_until}` or null. `finish(check)`: marks that row `done` with `finished_at` (never touches a newer queued row).
- `pending_for(lesson_id)` → `PendingCheckState{pending, newest_queued_hash, latest_stored_hash, latest_stored_at}`: `pending` is true while a queued or running `check_job` exists for a hash newer than the lesson's `checked_hash`; `latest_stored_*` are read from `lesson_doc` (read only).
**PgIssueRepo.** Issues are keyed to the content hash they were computed on.
- `replace_for_hash(lesson_id, content_hash, findings, tx)`: inserts one `issue` row per `CheckFinding` (`iss_…`, level, kind, message, address, span_anchor, related_lesson_id, code); for each finding whose **(kind, address, code)** matches an earlier resolved issue of the lesson it copies the resolution forward (`resolved_by`, `resolution_reason`, `resolved_at`, `cleared_by "resolution"`); a finding with a different key gets no carried resolution; earlier-hash issues that no longer appear are marked `cleared_by "fix"`. Returns `IssueSet{lesson_id, checked_hash, checked_at, issues}`.
- `current(lesson_id)` → the issue set of the newest checked hash (empty set with null hash before the first check); `get(issue_id)`; `resolve(r: NewResolution, tx)` sets `resolved_by`, `resolution_reason`, `resolved_at`, `cleared_by "resolution"` on an unresolved issue and returns the row (an already-resolved issue is returned unchanged); `resolutions_for(lesson_id)` → the latest resolved row per (kind, address, code) across all hashes (what `merge_resolutions` matches at Submit and Approve, G-14); `counts_by_lesson(unit_id)` → unresolved `blocking`, `confirmation` and `advisory` counts on each lesson's newest checked hash.
Must not: run any check; read lesson content; write `lesson_doc`, `alignment_link` or any other table; decide whether a kind is resolvable (the services do, CON-13); edit `lesson-docs.ts` (NL-36) or `lessons.ts` (NL-42).

### Sources
- DO-4 §3.4 (`ClaimedCheck`, `PendingCheckState`, `CheckQueue`, `PgCheckQueue`); §3.5 (`IssueRow`, `IssueSet`, `NewResolution`, `LessonIssueCounts`, `IssueRepo`, `PgIssueRepo`); §8 *checks* (`CheckFinding`, `merge_resolutions`)
- DO-3 §2.2 (`check-queue.ts`), §6 (`check_job`, `issue`), §7 (`CHECK_POLL_MS`, `UNCHECKED_AFTER_S`)
- CON-13 (agreed: issues as of a stored hash; `pending` true while a `check_job` exists for a stored hash newer than `checked_hash`; one coalesced `check_job` per store; resolvable kinds); CON-14 (resolutions), CON-18 (Submit and Approve match resolutions to the re-run); DO-1 D-6; PRD R-19, R-28
- DO-6 WF-10, *Missing instrumentation* 3 (every store has its check); DO-5 S2; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`check-queue.ts` NL-37)
- **Brief check:** serves "checks re-run on every save" (R-28) cheaply and visibly; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] Coalescing: three `enqueue` calls for one lesson with hashes H1, H2, H3 before any claim leave one `queued` row carrying H3 and its store id; after a claim of that row, a fourth enqueue (H4) adds a new `queued` row beside the running one (WF-10) — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.int.test.ts -t coalesce_to_newest` (Postgres 16 test container) — evidence: row dump after each step — covers: R-28, OBS-4, M-26
- [ ] AC-2 [invariant] `enqueue` is part of the caller's transaction: with the caller rolling back, no `check_job` row remains; committed, a `NOTIFY check_job` is received by a listening client — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.int.test.ts -t enqueue_joins_tx_and_notifies` — evidence: 2 cases — covers: R-28, OBS-4
- [ ] AC-3 [invariant] Two concurrent `claim(lease_ms)` calls on one queued row: exactly one gets a `ClaimedCheck`, the other null; a running row with a lapsed lease is reclaimed by the next `claim` and one with a live lease is not; `finish` marks only the claimed row `done` and leaves a newer queued row untouched — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.int.test.ts -t claim_skip_locked_and_lease` — evidence: 3 cases — covers: R-28, OBS-8
- [ ] AC-4 [invariant] `pending_for`: with a stored hash newer than the last checked hash it returns `pending true`, `newest_queued_hash`, `latest_stored_hash`, `latest_stored_at`; after `replace_for_hash` for that hash and `finish` it returns `pending false`; a lesson with no stored doc returns all-null, `pending false` — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.int.test.ts -t pending_for_states` — evidence: 3 cases — covers: R-28, CON-13
- [ ] AC-5 [invariant] `replace_for_hash(L, H2, findings)` stores one `issue` row per finding keyed to H2; `current(L)` returns exactly those with `checked_hash H2` and `checked_at`; the H1 rows still exist, unchanged except for `cleared_by` (WF-10) — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/issue-repo.int.test.ts -t issues_keyed_to_hash` — evidence: row sets for H1 and H2 — covers: R-19, R-28, OBS-4
- [ ] AC-6 [invariant] Resolutions carry forward by key only: an issue (kind `quote_placeholder_open`, address `…PartA`, code null) resolved on H1 appears resolved on H2 when the finding repeats with the same key (resolver, reason and time copied, `cleared_by resolution`), and is **not** resolved when the address or code differs — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/issue-repo.int.test.ts -t resolution_carries_by_key` — evidence: 3 cases — covers: R-34, CON-14
- [ ] AC-7 [invariant] An earlier-hash issue absent from the new run is marked `cleared_by "fix"` (and an earlier resolved one stays `resolution`); `counts_by_lesson(unit)` then counts only unresolved issues of each lesson's newest hash by level — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/issue-repo.int.test.ts -t fix_clearing_and_counts` — evidence: counts per lesson match fixtures — covers: R-25, M-2
- [ ] AC-8 [invariant] `resolutions_for(L)` returns the latest resolved row per (kind, address, code) across all hashes (two resolutions of one key on H1 and H3 → the H3 one), so `merge_resolutions` at Submit and Approve blocks on exactly what the issue list shows unresolved — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/issue-repo.int.test.ts -t resolutions_for_latest_per_key` — evidence: list of keyed rows — covers: R-34, CON-18
- [ ] AC-9 [failure/refusal] `resolve` on an already-resolved issue returns it unchanged (no second `resolved_at`); `resolve` and `get` of an unknown id return null/raise `NOT_FOUND` for the service to map; no repository method deletes or edits `message`, `kind` or `content_hash` of an existing issue — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/issue-repo.int.test.ts -t resolve_idempotent_and_immutable` — evidence: 3 cases — covers: R-35, CON-14
- [ ] AC-10 [invariant] Silence is visible (DO-6 missing-instrumentation 3): a `lesson_doc` hash with no `issue` set and no open `check_job` after `UNCHECKED_AFTER_S` (30 s, `FakeClock`) is returned by the operator query `unchecked_stores(now)` (a read-only function in this file), and such a lesson reports `pending true` — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.int.test.ts -t unchecked_stores_listed` — evidence: 1 listed lesson — covers: OBS-8, M-26
- [ ] AC-11 [capture] WF-10 component record: after store → enqueue → claim → `replace_for_hash` → finish for an edit that deletes a lesson's only checking item, a blocking `issue` exists for that hash, `check_job` carries `enqueued_at`, `claimed_at`, `finished_at` (so M-26's store-to-refreshed time is computable) and `pending_for` reads false (WF-10; the worker-level `test_checks_after_store_capture` is NL-81's) — verify: `npx vitest run packages/db/src/repos/check-queue.int.test.ts -t records_for_wf10` — evidence: row dump with timestamps — covers: OBS-1, OBS-4, M-26, M-7
- [ ] AC-12 [regression/context] area map rows for this ticket's paths planned → actual (A6 rows: `repos/check-queue.ts`); router and ICM rows if a route's evidence changed; one dev-log entry (Changed · Why · Checked · Remaining) — verify: `git diff --stat` and `python3 ~/.claude/skills/icm-project/scripts/check_context.py .` — evidence: diff touches only those rows; no FAIL — covers: — (component of a larger flow; the integrating ticket proves the requirement)

Acceptance anchor: infra: CON-13's `pending` and key-matching rules and DO-1 D-6 (coalesced check lane) — AC-1, AC-4 and AC-6 are their tests; no worked pair applies to a queue.

- Capture evidence: AC-11 (component level; the worker-level `test_checks_after_store_capture` is NL-81's)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or

### Story
US-12 — As a reviewer (P-1), I need to see that a lesson depends on another lesson and to be stopped from approving it before its source is ready, so the checks need the other lesson's stored text, the pending suggestions and the open safety flags. Three callers (the check worker, the Submit freeze and Approve) must build the same context, or the blocking set would differ between the issue list, Submit and Approve.

### What to build
**Module:** `packages/core/src/checks/context-loader.ts` — `CheckContextLoader` (DO-4 §6), constructor `(outlines, standards, graph, reader, suggestions, flags, alignment, clock)` with ports only (`OutlineRepo`, `StandardRepo`, `LessonGraphRepo`, `LessonDocReader`, `SuggestionRepo`, `SafetyFlagRepo`, `AlignmentRepo`, `Clock`); no `pg`, no SDK import (the boundaries lint from NL-01 checks `packages/core`). Callers: `CheckJobRunner` (NL-81), `CollabCommandHandler.lock_and_snapshot` (NL-106), `ApproveService` (NL-53), and `CompileCheckNode` (NL-29) at draft time.
`load(lesson_id, lesson, content_hash) → CheckContext`. The lesson content is **passed in** (the stored derived row for the worker, the freshly stored row at Submit, the frozen snapshot at Approve); the loader never reads the lesson itself from storage, so the same function checks exactly the content its caller names.
- `row`, `arc_header`: `outlines.row_context(outline_version_id, lesson_id, null)` (the version's stored choices, since this is outside a run). The outline version is resolved once, here (DO-4 §6 `CheckContextLoader.load`, §13 R-14; `load` keeps its three arguments so its callers cannot disagree): `graph.source_outline_version(lesson_id)` (the run that produced the newest `generated` or wholly adopted `candidate` version; NL-42), else the unit's `latest_outline_version_id` (the unit is the lesson id minus its last segment); the version used is recorded in `CheckContext.outline_version_id`. A re-upload after generation therefore does not change the row a generated lesson is compared against (G-24: a run pins its outline version).
- `allowed_codes`: the row's `focus_codes`, `eld_codes` and `msls_codes` expanded to their listed leaves with `standards.index().leaves_of`; `standards`: `standards.texts(allowed_codes ∪ the codes in lesson.front_matter.standards)`.
- `text_cards`: `lesson.text_cards`; `links`: the row context's `lesson_link` records.
- `linked_lessons`: for each `graph.dependencies(lesson_id)` entry and each `graph.dependants` lesson, `reader.latest_derived(id)` (the other lesson's **stored** row, R-28 as amended); a linked lesson with no stored doc is omitted.
- `pending_suggestions`: `suggestions.pending_for(lesson_id, clock.now())` (expired ones excluded); `safety_flags`: `flags.open_for(lesson_id)`; `confirmations`: `alignment.for_lesson(lesson_id)` rows whose `origin` is `narrowed` or `added`.
- `previous_lesson_flags` (DO-4 §6, §13 R-1): the `lesson`-kind row just before this one in `outlines.rows(outline_version_id)` (flex days count; arc headers and totals do not) → `flags.open_for(that lesson)`; empty for the first lesson. `unit_coverage` (§13 R-2): `alignment.coverage_rows(unit_id)`, unchanged.
- A lesson with no outline row raises `InvariantViolation` with the lesson id (a data fault, never a silent empty context).
Must not: read or write the lesson being checked; hold state between calls; call `run_checks` (callers do); edit `registry.ts`, `policy.ts`, `gates.ts` (NL-20) or any repository.

### Sources
- DO-4 §6 (`CheckContext`, `CheckContextLoader`); §3.5 (`RowContext`, `OutlineRepo.row_context`, `StandardRepo`, `LessonGraphRepo`, `SuggestionRepo.pending_for`, `SafetyFlagRepo.open_for`, `AlignmentRepo.for_lesson`, `DependencyState`); §3.4 (`LessonDocReader.latest_derived`, `DerivedRow`); §10.2 `InvariantViolation`
- DO-3 §2.1 (`context-loader.ts`), §3 (ports), §5 (*`CheckContextLoader` in `packages/core` over ports*: three callers must build the same context)
- CON-13 (agreed: cross-lesson checks read the other lesson's stored row; `cross_lesson_link` blocking rules), CON-18 (Submit and Approve re-run on the stored copy or the snapshot); PRD R-28 as amended, R-34, R-20; HP-4, HP-5
- WP-1 (`docs/data/worked-pairs.md`: Lesson 4 Homework → Lesson 5 excerpt slot link); DO-6 WF-10, WF-15; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`context-loader.ts` NL-38)
- **Brief check:** serves "checks on every save, Submit and Approve" with one shared context (R-28, R-34); touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

## [NL-39] checks: alignment (taught + checked; listed / narrowed / added; leaf only), safety (tip present, no 6-word leak, disclosure prompts), cross-lesson link, pending suggestion, open flag

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-12 / US-19 / US-20 — As a reviewer I need the system to prove, from the stored lesson, that every focus standard is taught *and* checked, that every AI-proposed code waits for a named person, and that a content warning reaches the teacher tip without leaking into student text, so that Approve is refused for the right reasons. This ticket writes the rule bodies; NL-37/38/81 run them, NL-45 serves them.

### What to build
Fill the bodies of the rule files NL-20 left as stubs returning `[]` (Metz C1: bodies only, never the registry, policy, gates or types). Each rule is a pure `CheckRule.run(ctx: CheckContext, policy: CheckPolicy) -> CheckFinding[]`, never throws for content, never reads the database. Findings carry `kind`, `level`, `message`, `address`, `span_anchor`, `related_lesson_id` and `code`; the message names the address and the kind, never repeats a safety note's text.
**`packages/core/src/checks/rules/alignment/`** — `standard_not_taught` and `standard_not_checked` (blocking: each *focus* standard needs a teaching part and a `cfu_item` tagged with it; derives `CheckResult.alignment` rows `AlignmentLinkRow{code, address, role I/P/A, origin, asserted_by}` — never an empty `asserted_by`, GR-4); `code_not_allowed` (blocking: a code outside the row's lists that is not a leaf of a listed parent, or any non-leaf code); `standard_confirmation` (level `confirmation`: origin `narrowed` or `added` with no `confirmed_by` in `ctx.confirmations`; HP-3 — counted in `CheckResult.confirmation`, not `blocking`); `standard_add_suggestion` (advisory: an unlisted leaf of a listed parent, "add?", never added silently); `eld_label_mismatch` (advisory: an ELD code whose strand does not match the row's ELD label, using `ctx.standards[].eld_strand` and the seeded verdict table).
**`rules/safety/`** — `safety_flag_open` (blocking per open flag in `ctx.safety_flags`, `related` to its `teacher_tip_address`); `safety_note_without_tip` (blocking: a flag/confirmed note with no `teacher_tip` block carrying its id); `safety_text_in_student_block` (blocking: a run of ≥ `policy.safety_run_min_words` = 6 words of the note's original text in a student-facing block — assignment items, `directions`, student-facing prompts); `disclosure_prompt` (patterns "a time you…", "your own experience", "have you ever…", "in your family" in student-facing prompts: blocking in the flagged lesson **and the next** — the lesson with an open flag in `ctx.safety_flags`, or whose `ctx.previous_lesson_flags` is non-empty (DO-4 §6, §13 R-1) — advisory elsewhere; per-finding `level`).
**`rules/links/`** — `cross_lesson_link` (blocking while a linked lesson's stored row has the slot the dependant points to empty; `related_lesson_id` = the source lesson; reads `ctx.linked_lessons`, never another lesson's live document); `linked_text_changed` (the linked lesson's current hash differs from the one this lesson recorded); `suggestion_pending` (blocking per pending, unexpired suggestion in `ctx.pending_suggestions`, CON-17).
Must not: edit `registry.ts`, `policy.ts`, `gates.ts`, `types.ts`, `rules/structural/**`, `rules/grounding/**`, `rules/arc/**` (other owners), or add a `CheckKind`. Settled (DO-4 §13): the "and the next" scope reads `ctx.previous_lesson_flags`, filled by NL-38 (R-1); `vocabulary_word_missing` is blocking and belongs to NL-20's structural group, not this ticket (R-8).

### Sources

- CON-13 (agreed: issue kinds, levels, `narrowed`/`added` as `confirmation`, safety flag linked to its `teacher_tip`, UXP-2 `cross_lesson_link`); CON-17 (a pending suggestion blocks Submit and Approve); INTERFACE shared guarantee 11
- HP-3 (alignment origins), HP-9 (safety: tight pattern list, 6-word run, disclosure patterns), HP-5 (cross-lesson link); PRD R-19, R-20, R-21, R-22, R-34 (§5.4 amendments); GR-4, GR-12

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-17 / US-18 — As a reviewer I need every quotation, page number and name in a generated lesson to be either from the outline row or flagged, and every excerpt to carry a source and a rights status, so that no invented quote reaches an approved lesson (V-3: 100% sourced or placeholder).

### What to build
Fill the bodies of the grounding rule files NL-20 stubbed. Pure functions; port the scan logic from the SP-3 harness (`spike/SP-3`, `spikes/sp3/harness`; do not import it) with the values SP-3 settled: **quote span ≥ 3 words**, quote and page scans **blocking in every block role**, name scan from the **capitalised-token heuristic plus `compromise`**, blocking **only inside `cfu_item` options and rationales**, advisory elsewhere (`CheckPolicy.name_scan_scope = "blocking_in_cfu_items"`).
**`packages/core/src/checks/rules/grounding/`** — `quote_unmatched` (blocking: any quotation-mark span of ≥ `policy.quote_span_min_words` words, a word being a token with a letter or digit, that is not a substring of the lesson's own row cells, `ctx.arc_header`, a `ctx.text_cards` title or the official `ctx.standards` text; titles in quotes and the row's own quoted words pass); `page_out_of_range` (blocking: a page **or chapter** reference outside the row's range, read from the text card/segment); `proper_noun_unsourced` (a proper noun not in the row, arc header, text cards or standards text, minus a routine/section-name allow-list kept in `grounding/allow-list.ts`; per-finding `level` = `blocking` inside a `cfu_item` option or rationale, `advisory` elsewhere); `quote_without_source` (blocking: a `quote` node with no `source_ref`); `quote_too_long` (blocking: a reviewer-inserted `quote` with rights `short-quote-commentary` over `policy.reviewer_quote_max_words` = 12 words); `rights_to_clear` (blocking: a `quote`/excerpt with rights `to-clear`, GR-3); `quote_placeholder_open` and `excerpt_slot_open` (blocking: a `text_evidence_needed` block or an excerpt slot still unfilled; `address` of the block). A sentence split across ProseMirror text nodes is joined before the span scan.
Must not: invent a threshold (read `policy`), reach the network or a model, treat the name scan as blocking outside `cfu_item`s, edit NL-20's files or another group's folder, or copy any text from `docs/source/restricted/` into fixtures (seeded copies are built from SP-1's drafts and SYN data only, GR-9). Plan correction for the orchestrator: the plan gives `quote_placeholder_open` / `excerpt_slot_open` to no ticket; this one takes them (they are the grounding placeholders).

### Sources
- DO-4 §8 *checks* (`CheckPolicy`, `CheckFinding`, `CheckResult`, `CheckRule`, `CheckRuleList`), §6 `CheckContext`; DO-3 §2.1 (`checks/rules/*.ts`, `checks/policy.ts`) and §4 A6a row; slice plan *Collision map* W2 (NL-20 owns `registry/policy/gates/types.ts`, `rules/structural/**` and the empty `rules/<group>/index.ts` shells) and W3

- HP-2 option B and its *How we'll know it worked*; SP-3 record `docs/analysis/spikes/SP-3-invention-scans.md` (results table, limits); PRD R-12, R-19; GR-1, GR-2, GR-3
- WP-1 (2 placeholders), WP-2 (1 excerpt slot, `to-clear`), WP-3 (0 placeholders, 0 grounding flags); DO-5 S4
- **Brief check:** serves "referencing text/novel indicated in the provided unit outline sheet"; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

## [NL-41] checks: arc continuity advisory rules (R-9)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-12 — As a reviewer I need a quiet hint when a unit's arc drifts (the same opening routine three lessons running, homework that does not match the next lesson, a performance-task skill nobody practises, a vocabulary list over the cap), so that I look at it without it blocking approval. Cuttable (PD-17 #3): if the cut fires this ticket is dropped and the registry keeps its stub.

### What to build
Fill the bodies of the arc rule files NL-20 stubbed; advisory only, never blocking, never throws.
**`packages/core/src/checks/rules/arc/`** — `arc_repeat` (advisory: the same primary activity type within any 3-lesson window ending at this lesson, and homework pages that do not match the next lesson's reading; compares this lesson's `ctx.lesson` and `ctx.row` with `ctx.linked_lessons`/`ctx.links` neighbours' stored rows; raised on the *later* lesson, e.g. L8 for L6–L8); `vocabulary_over_cap` (advisory: more vocabulary words in front matter than `policy.vocabulary_cap`). ## [NL-42] review: lessons, versions, snapshots, review events, last editor, dependants, approved snapshots

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-29 — As anyone who must answer "who changed this lesson, when, and from which version", I need every lesson, every immutable version and every state move stored in one place that can only be appended to. Platform work: Submit (collab), Approve and reopen (web), the board, history and export all read and write through this repository, so it lands before them.

### What to build
Implement `PgLessonRepo` in `packages/db/src/repos/lessons.ts`: one class implementing the three ports `LessonStateRepo`, `LessonVersionRepo` and `LessonGraphRepo` (DO-4 §3.5, `ports/lesson-state.ts`, `lesson-versions.ts`, `lesson-graph.ts`), over the tables NL-08 already created (`lesson`, `lesson_version`, `review_event`, `lesson_link`; no DDL here). It is built by `PgRepo_ctor{db, ids, clock}` (DO-4 §12) and every write method takes the caller's `Tx` so a service commits several repos at once.
**State port.** `get`, `state_of` (`LessonStateInfo{editable}` from `is_editable`), `lock_for_update` (`SELECT … FOR UPDATE` inside the caller's tx), `ensure_lessons(rows, unit_id, tx)` (idempotent: one `lesson` row per outline lesson row, id `G6.U4.L<n>`, state `draft`, returns the number newly created), `set_state(lesson_id, to_state, reviewer_id, tx)`, `append_review_event(NewReviewEvent, tx)` (one append-only `review_event` row with `request_id`; there is no update or delete method), `record_last_editor`.
**Version port.** `write_generated_version` (kinds `generated`/`candidate`; `idempotency_key` UNIQUE with `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, returns the existing row and `created: false` on a repeat, HP-7 mechanic 3; a `candidate` has `adopted = false` and never changes `lesson.current_version_id`, R-29); `write_snapshot` (`submit`/`approve`/`reopen`: next `number`, **inherits** `outline_row_hash`, `prompt_version_id`, `schema_version`, `run_id` from the generated version it descends from, sets `derived_from_version_id`, leaves model fields null and `cost_usd` 0 — INTERFACE CON-19 system rule); `version`, `latest_snapshot`, `candidate(lesson_id, candidate_id)` (null for another lesson's id), `has_generated_version`, `approved_snapshots(unit_id)` (the latest `approve` snapshot of each lesson whose state is `approved` or `exported`; a `reopened` lesson is excluded until re-approved).
**Graph port.** `dependencies(lesson_id)` → `DependencyState[]` from `lesson_link` (`waits_on` / `depended_on_by`, `slot_id`, `source_state`, `source_approved_hash` from the source's latest `approve` snapshot, `slot_filled` read-only from the source's latest `lesson_doc.derived_json`; NL-36 owns `lesson_doc` writes) and `dependants(lesson_id)`.
**Board rows** are not this ticket's: `PgBoardReadRepo` lives in `repos/metrics.ts` and is written by that file's owner, NL-48 (DO-4 §3.5, DO-3 §4 A13a; §13 R-9).
**Added by DO-4 §13:** `mark_adopted(version_id, tx)` (R-5): `UPDATE lesson_version SET adopted = true WHERE version_id = $1 AND kind = 'candidate' AND adopted = false RETURNING *`; zero rows → `DomainRefusal(INVALID_TRANSITION)`; section adopts never call it. `source_outline_version(lesson_id)` on the graph port (R-14): the `outline_version_id` of the run named by `provenance.run_id` of the lesson's newest `generated` version or `adopted` candidate, null when it has neither (one query joining `lesson_version` and `run`, read-only).
Must not: write DDL, edit `ports.ts` (NL-12), write `lesson_doc` rows, or log lesson text. Tests use the real Postgres container (Postgres 16 test container); the in-memory twin of these ports is NL-12's.

### Sources
- DO-4 §3.5 (`LessonRow`, `LessonVersionRow`, `ProvenanceRecord`, `NewGeneratedVersion`, `NewSnapshot`, `NewReviewEvent`, `ReviewEventRow`, `DependencyState`, `BoardRowRecord`, `LessonStateInfo`, `GeneratedVersionWrite`, `LessonStateRepo`, `LessonVersionRepo`, `LessonGraphRepo`, `BoardReadRepo`, `PgLessonRepo`), §12 constructors; DO-3 §2.2 (`repos/lessons.ts`), §4 A12a, §6 (`lesson`, `lesson_version`, `review_event`, `lesson_link`), *History view*
- CON-11 (`version_number`, snapshot fields), CON-18 (states, `review_event` per move), CON-19 provenance rule, CON-23 (approved snapshots only), CON-9 (board row fields); R-35, GR-8, GR-15; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (repos: lessons NL-42)
- HP-4 (which copy is canonical), HP-5 addendum (dependency record), HP-7 mechanic 3 (idempotent store)
- **Brief check:** serves "Import the generated lesson content into a system for persistence and tracking, so that next steps of editing, approval, finalization can take place"; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

## [NL-43] review: safety-flag, alignment-link and suggestion repositories

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-19 / US-20 — As a reviewer I clear a safety flag with a note, confirm or remove an AI-proposed standard, and see AI suggestions held outside the lesson; each is a row that names the person and the time. Platform work: the issue list, resolve, assist and coverage tickets read and write these rows.

### What to build
Implement three classes in `packages/db/src/repos/review-extras.ts` (DO-4 §3.5), over the tables NL-08 created (`safety_flag`, `alignment_link`, `suggestion`; no DDL here), each write taking the caller's `Tx`:
**`PgSafetyFlagRepo`** — `create_for_lesson(lesson_id, source_rows, tx)` (one `open` flag per source row; a repeat creates none), `open_for(lesson_id)`, `clear(flag_id, by, note, tx)` (sets `status cleared`, `cleared_by`, `note`, `cleared_at`; an empty or whitespace note throws and changes nothing — the service's `NOTE_REQUIRED` is NL-45; clearing a cleared flag throws `InvariantViolation`, never overwrites the first clear).
**`PgAlignmentRepo`** — `replace_for_hash(lesson_id, content_hash, links, tx)` (replaces the rows of that lesson and hash, keeps `confirmed_by` for an identical `(code, address, origin)` carried onto the new hash, returns the row count), `confirm(lesson_id, code, by, decision, tx)` (reading of CON-14, planner confirms: `confirm` sets `confirmed_by` on the code's rows at the current hash; `remove` deletes the code's rows at the current hash, the re-run after the collaboration edit rewrites the set; `add` writes rows with `origin "added"`, `asserted_by "reviewer"` and `confirmed_by` null so it opens its own confirmation), `for_lesson`, `coverage_rows(unit_id)` (one SQL statement: a `CoverageCell` per code × lesson × role with `confirmation` = `person` when `confirmed_by` or `asserted_by = reviewer`, `judge_only`, or `generator_only`, and `source` per DO-4 §3.5 / §13 R-11: per lesson, the rows at its latest `approve` snapshot's hash (`approved`) where one exists, else at its latest `lesson_doc` derived hash (`working`); cut #4's CON-22 reads it). `restore(lesson_id, code, rows, tx)` (DO-4 §13 R-4, the CON-14 undo): replaces the rows for `(lesson_id, code)` at the lesson's latest hash with `rows`, confirmation included; returns the count.
**`PgSuggestionRepo`** — `insert`, `get` (a pending row past `expires_at` is read back as `closed`), `decide(suggestion_id, status, by, tx)` (only from `pending`; a second decision throws `InvariantViolation`), `pending_for(lesson_id, now)` (excludes expired). `NewSuggestion.expires_at` is set by the service (`now + SUGGESTION_TTL_MIN`) and stored as given; the repo reads no settings (DO-4 §3.5, §13 R-3).
Must not: write DDL, edit `ports.ts` (NL-12), store a person's review minutes, or return `selected_text` in any log. Tests use the Postgres container.

### Sources
- DO-4 §3.5 (`SafetyFlagRow`, `SafetyFlagRepo`, `AlignmentLinkRow`, `CoverageCell`, `AlignmentRepo`, `NewSuggestion`, `SuggestionRow`, `SuggestionRepo` and the three `Pg…` classes); DO-3 §2.2 (`repos/review-extras.ts`), §4 A12a, §6 (`safety_flag`, `alignment_link`, `suggestion`), §7 `SUGGESTION_TTL_MIN`
- CON-14 (flag clear: user, note, time; confirm/remove/add), CON-13 (confirmation items), CON-17 (30 min expiry, pending blocks), CON-22 (one-query coverage); PRD R-20, R-22, R-31; GR-4

## [NL-44] review: lesson read (derived row or snapshot) and history

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-13 / US-14 / US-29 — As a reviewer, author or approver I open a lesson and see everything the workspace and the approval review need in one answer (content, standards with who asserted them, texts, outline row, checklist, dependencies), and I can read its full history: every version, its provenance and every audited action.

### What to build
Implement `LessonReadService` in `apps/web/src/server/services/lesson-read-service.ts` (DO-4 §5) and the two routes. Read-only: it opens no transaction and writes nothing, not even an audit row (INTERFACE shared guarantee 5).
**`get_lesson(user, lesson_id)`** (`getLesson`, `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/route.ts`): accepts `G6.U4.L4` or `g6-u4:L4` (UXQ-2, normalised by the id parser in `packages/schema`); `states.get` (`NOT_FOUND`); reads the **derived row** (`LessonDocReader.latest_derived`) for editable states and the **latest snapshot** (`LessonVersionRepo.latest_snapshot`) for `submitted`, `approved`, `exported`; `assert_known_nodes` over the content → `SchemaUnknownError` → `SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` (500, `details` names the lesson and schema version; nothing dropped). Builds the CON-11 response: ids/keys, `state`, `version_number`, `content_hash`, `state_vector`, `schema_version`, `last_editor`; `snapshot{version_id, content_hash, state_vector}` for submitted and later; `front_matter.standards[]` with `origin`, `official_text`, `asserted_by` and `confirmation` (from `AlignmentRepo`, official CDE text only); `sections` with addresses; `text_cards`; `outline_row` with segments (from `OutlineRepo`); `alignment_map`; `reviewer`; `send_back`; `dependencies`; `checklist` for submitted and later (keys `standards`, `quotes_and_rights`, `eld_support`, `content_safety`, `ai_spans`, `dependencies`, the ones that apply, status `ok|open`, `evidence_refs`); and `allowed_actions` as a hint from `transition_roles`/`decide_transition` (NL-21) — `start_review` only for a reviewer on a `draft` (UXQ-11). The constructor includes `issues: IssueRepo`, `flags: SafetyFlagRepo`, `graph: LessonGraphRepo` for the checklist and dependency lines (DO-4 §5 `LessonReadService`, §13 R-6). All text is returned as text, never HTML (R-58); no minutes or person-level metric appears (GR-15).
**`history(user, lesson_id)`** (`getLessonHistory`, `…/history/route.ts`): `versions` (id, number, kind with `approve` shown as `approval`, hash, created_at/by, `adopted`, provenance — every version non-null; human-made versions inherit and show empty model fields, cost 0), `audit` from `AuditLog.history` (view `audit_log_v`), `ai_spans` (accepted by, at).
Must not: write anything, read the live document, edit `app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/` folders other than `route.ts` and `history/**`, or fill `wiring/review.ts` (NL-53).

## [NL-45] review: issue list as of a hash (`pending`), resolutions, safety-flag clear, standard decisions with undo

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-16 / US-19 / US-20 / US-21 — As a reviewer I see exactly what is wrong with a lesson and what stops Submit or Approve, I clear a block with a named reason, clear a safety flag with a note, and confirm or remove an AI-proposed standard (with a short undo), so that every approval rests on a person's recorded decision.

### What to build
Implement `IssueService` in `apps/web/src/server/services/issue-service.ts` (DO-4 §5) and the routes `lessons/[lessonId]/issues/route.ts`, `issues/[issueId]/resolution/route.ts`, `safety-flags/[flagId]/clear/route.ts`, `standards/decision/route.ts` (collision map: `issues/**`, `safety-flags/**`, `standards/**`).
**`get_issues`** (`getLessonIssues`, any role): `IssueRepo.current` + `CheckQueue.pending_for` → `stored_hash` (latest stored), `checked_hash`, `checked_at`, `pending` (a newer stored hash is queued), `counts` over **unresolved** issues by level, and each issue with `blocks` (level `blocking`/`confirmation` → `[submit, approve]`, advisory → `[]`), `resolvable` (false for `suggestion_pending`, `standard_confirmation`, `safety_flag_open`, `safety_note_without_tip`, `safety_text_in_student_block`, `rights_to_clear`, `cross_lesson_link`) and `resolution{by, reason, at}`. UXP-2 reading, planner confirms: for each `LessonGraphRepo.dependencies` entry whose slot is filled but whose source is not approved, the list carries a `cross_lesson_link` entry with `blocks ["approve"]`.
**`record_resolution`** (`reviewer`): precedence role → lesson `NOT_FOUND` / issue not on this lesson `NOT_FOUND` → `LESSON_LOCKED` (not editable) → `REASON_REQUIRED` (blank reason, 422) → `NOT_RESOLVABLE` (422, `details.use` names the right action, e.g. `clearSafetyFlag`, `decideStandard`, `decideSuggestion`, `fillSlot`); then one tx: `IssueRepo.resolve` + `AuditLog.append` (`issue.resolve`, `version_hash` = the issue's hash, reason). **`clear_safety_flag`** (`reviewer` or `approver`): allowed on `submitted`; `LESSON_LOCKED` on `approved`, `exported` and a `draft` whose review has not started; blank note → `NOTE_REQUIRED` (flag stays open); one tx: `SafetyFlagRepo.clear` + audit (`safety_flag.clear`). Neither touches the document or its hash. **`decide_standard`** (`reviewer`): `confirm`/`remove`/`add` go to `CollabCommands.apply_edit(StandardEdit, tag "standard-decision")` first (`COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` → nothing recorded; counts as an edit for four-eyes), then one tx records `AlignmentRepo.confirm` + audit; every decision's audit row carries `details {code, decision, undo_of, before_entry, before_links}` (the code's front-matter entry and `alignment_link` rows before the decision; codes and CDE text only). **`undo`** (DO-4 §5 `IssueService.decide_standard`, §3.3 `StandardEdit`, §3.5 `StandardDecisionRow`, `AuditLog.standard_decisions`, `AlignmentRepo.restore`; §13 R-4; CON-14 as agreed): role → lesson `NOT_FOUND`, or `undo_of` not among `audit.standard_decisions(lesson_id, code)` or not the caller's → `NOT_FOUND` → `LESSON_LOCKED` → `UNDO_EXPIRED` (409) when `now − target.at > UNDO_WINDOW_S` (60) or the target is not the newest decision on the code (an undo is itself a decision, so a second undo expires) → `apply_edit(StandardEdit{decision "undo", code, restore: target.before_entry})` → one tx: `alignment.restore(lesson_id, code, target.before_links)` + audit (`standard.undo`); status `undone`. `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` → nothing recorded.
All writes in one `TxRunner.with_tx`; a refusal writes nothing, not even an audit row (one application-log line). Responses: `item_id`, `status`, `by`, `at`, `audit_id`, the lesson's new `counts`.
Must not: write lesson content itself (collaboration server only, CON-G3), edit `wiring/review.ts` (NL-53), or resolve a kind outside the resolvable list.

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 (`IssueService`, `RouteSpec`), §3.3 (`CollabCommands`, `StandardEdit`, `EditCommand`, `StoreAck`), §3.4 (`CheckQueue`, `PendingCheckState`), §3.5 (`IssueRow`, `IssueSet`, `NewResolution`, `IssueRepo`, `SafetyFlagRepo`, `AlignmentRepo`, `AuditLog`), §10.1 error codes, §7 settings `UNDO_WINDOW_S`; DO-3 §2.3 (`issue-service.ts`), §4 A12
- CON-13 and CON-14 (agreed: levels, `blocks`, resolvable kinds, errors and precedence, undo window); INTERFACE shared guarantees 1–4, 11; UXP-2, UXQ-8; PRD R-20, R-22, R-34 (§5.4); GR-4, GR-12
- WP-4 (row 39 flag blocks Approve until cleared with a note), WP-1 (`L.6.4.b` confirm); DO-6 WF-8, WF-11; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (issues, safety-flags, standards NL-45)

## [NL-46] review: fill a placeholder or excerpt slot through the collaboration server

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-17 / US-18 — As a reviewer I replace a "Reviewer to insert" placeholder or an excerpt slot with a real quote from a source I verified, with its source and rights status, so that the lesson's evidence is real and V-3 (100% of quotes sourced) holds.

### What to build
Implement `SlotService` in `apps/web/src/server/services/slot-service.ts` (DO-4 §5) and the route `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/slots/[slotId]/fill/route.ts` (`fillSlot`, role `reviewer`, 200).
`fill(user, lesson_id, slot_id, req)` in CON-15's precedence: role → lesson `NOT_FOUND` → `LESSON_LOCKED` (state not editable per `is_editable`, nothing sent) → missing-input checks **before any edit**: `SOURCE_REQUIRED` (422: `source_ref` has none of `book`/`title`, `chapter`, `pages`, `url`) and `QUOTE_TOO_LONG` (422: rights `short-quote-commentary` with more than `CheckPolicy.reviewer_quote_max_words` = 12 words; a word is a token with a letter or digit, punctuation-only tokens do not count) → `CollabCommands.apply_edit(EditCommand{edit: SlotFillEdit{slot_id, text, source_ref, rights_status}, tag "slot-fill", actor: the reviewer})`. The collaboration server inserts the `quote` node as plain text in one Yjs transaction and stores at once; this service returns after that store: `slot_id`, `inserted_by`, `inserted_at`, `content_hash` (the stored hash from `StoreAck`), `still_blocking` (true when rights are `to-clear`, with `blocking_reason "rights to clear"`), and `linked_lessons` (lessons whose link this slot feeds with their new status, e.g. waiting on Lesson 5's approval, UXP-2). A collab refusal passes through with its own code (`LESSON_LOCKED`, `NOT_FOUND` for a slot a co-editor deleted); transport failure → `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing inserted. Re-filling a filled slot replaces the quote (how a `to-clear` is later recorded as cleared). `linked_lessons` comes from the constructor's `graph: LessonGraphRepo` (`dependants`; DO-4 §5 `SlotService`, §13 R-6).
Must not: validate by writing, touch lesson content from the web process (CON-G3), accept text over 10,000 characters (OpenAPI `maxLength`, `INVALID_REQUEST`), render text as HTML, or edit another `lessons/[lessonId]/` folder.

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 (`SlotService`), §3.3 (`SlotFillEdit`, `EditCommand`, `StoreAck`, `CollabCommands.apply_edit`, `HttpCollabCommandClient` mapping), §8 (`CheckPolicy`, `is_editable`), §10.1; DO-3 §2.3 (`slot-service.ts`), §4 A12
- CON-15 (agreed: errors, precedence, word rule, `to-clear` blocks, plain text, UXP-2); INTERFACE shared guarantees 2, 3, 11; PRD R-12; GR-2, GR-3; HP-2 (U6, U10)
- WP-1 (Part A placeholder), WP-2 (excerpt slot, rights `to-clear`); DO-6 WF-12; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`slots/**` NL-46)
- **Brief check:** serves "referencing text/novel indicated in the provided unit outline sheet"; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

- [ ] AC-2 [failure/refusal] no source → `SOURCE_REQUIRED` and a 13-word `short-quote-commentary` quote → `QUOTE_TOO_LONG`, each 422 with **zero** `apply_edit` calls; 12 words passes; punctuation-only tokens are not counted — verify: `slot-service.test.ts::missing_input_before_edit` — evidence: calls == 0, 12-word case calls == 1 — covers: GR-3, CON-15, CON-G2
