## [NL-47] review: regenerate as candidate, read, adopt

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-22 / US-10 — As a reviewer I can ask for a fresh draft of a lesson without losing the one I have: the new draft arrives beside the current one as a candidate, I read it, and I adopt the whole thing or one section as a recorded edit under my name.

### What to build
Implement `CandidateService` in `apps/web/src/server/services/candidate-service.ts` (DO-4 §5) and routes under `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/candidates/**` (`regenerateLesson` POST → 202; `getCandidate` GET `…/{candidateId}`; `adoptCandidate` POST `…/{candidateId}/adopt`).
**`regenerate`** (`reviewer`): precedence role → `NOT_FOUND` → `LESSON_LOCKED` (state `submitted`, `approved`, `exported`, or a `draft` whose review has not started, UXP-3; `generation_failed`, `in_review`, `changes_requested` and `reopened` are allowed) → card conditions: if a candidate job for the lesson is queued or running, return that candidate (202) and spend nothing; else `SpendLedger.check_day_cap(user, cap_usd)` (`DAY_CAP_REACHED` with `details.scope` `user`|`project`, remaining) where `cap_usd` is one lesson's worst case (the draft, the truncation retry and one repair reservations at the pinned model price, from `max_call_cost`; it never draws on the original run's cap) → one tx: `RunRepo.insert_run` (kind `candidate`, `parent_run_id` = the lesson's run, the run's stored plan and pinned prompt reused, optional reviewer `note` carried as `NewJob.reviewer_note` to the draft prompt, DO-4 §3.4, §13 R-15) + `JobQueue.create_candidate_job` + `AuditLog.append` (`candidate.regenerate`); `NOTIFY` after commit. A race on the partial unique index returns the winner's candidate. The worker (NL-29) generates; the lesson row and current version are untouched; on `generation_failed` the candidate path stores v1 directly (the shared state table).
**`get`** (any role): the candidate version beside `current_content_hash` (unchanged), `status` (`queued`, `drafting`, `ready`, `failed`) from the job and version rows, `failure_reasons` in CON-6 vocabulary, `cost_usd`, `sections` when ready; a candidate of another lesson → `NOT_FOUND`. A failed candidate is a status, not an error.
**`adopt`** (`reviewer`): `INVALID_TRANSITION` (409) unless `ready` and not already adopted whole; `scope "section"` needs `section_address` (else `INVALID_REQUEST`); `CollabCommands.apply_edit(AdoptEdit{candidate_version_id, scope, section_address}, tag "candidate-adopt", actor)` — the adopter becomes last editor via the collaboration store; then one tx: for `whole`, `LessonVersionRepo.mark_adopted(candidate_version_id, tx)` (DO-4 §3.5, §13 R-5; zero rows → `INVALID_TRANSITION`), for `section` no flag change, + `AuditLog.append` (`candidate.adopt`, details `scope`, `section_address`); response `candidate_id`, `audit_id`, `last_editor`, new `content_hash`. `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` leaves everything unchanged.
Must not: overwrite or edit the current version, write lesson content from the web process, draw on the original run's cap, or fill `wiring/review.ts` (NL-53).

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 (`CandidateService`), §3.4 (`JobQueue.create_candidate_job`, `SpendLedger.check_day_cap`), §3.5 (`RunRepo`, `NewRun`, `LessonVersionRepo.candidate`, `has_generated_version`), §3.3 (`AdoptEdit`, `EditCommand`), §8 (`max_call_cost`), §10.1; DO-3 §2.3 (`candidate-service.ts`), §4 A12, §6 (`run.kind`, `lesson_job` partial unique index)
- CON-16 (agreed: errors, one job in flight, own cap, adoption is a logged edit); CON-6 (failure reasons); INTERFACE shared guarantees 2, 3, 11; UXP-3; PRD R-29, R-8, R-35; GR-7, GR-8
- WP-1 (regenerate an in-review L4 → candidate v(n+1) "not adopted"); DO-6 WF-13; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`candidates/**` NL-47)
- **Brief check:** serves "Have a UI/UX for reviewing and editing/updating a lesson's content in the system (wysiwyg), and AI assisted tooling as helpful."; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] regenerating WP-1's in-review L4 creates one `run` (kind `candidate`, `parent_run_id` set), one candidate job, one `audit_event` (`candidate.regenerate`) and returns 202 with `status queued`, `adopted false`, `current_content_hash` equal to the lesson's current hash; the lesson state and `current_version_id` are unchanged (WF-13) — verify: ``apps/web/src/server/services/candidate-service.test.ts::regenerate_creates_candidate_only` — evidence: rows read back; hash equal — covers: R-29, GR-7, M-11
- [ ] AC-2 [invariant] a second `regenerate` while a candidate job is queued or running returns that candidate (202) and creates no run, no job, no reservation and no audit row; the race on the unique index returns the winner — verify: `candidate-service.test.ts::second_call_returns_inflight` and `::unique_index_race` — evidence: row counts unchanged — covers: R-29, CON-16, M-29
- [ ] AC-3 [failure/refusal] `LESSON_LOCKED` on `submitted`, `approved`, `exported` and a never-reviewed `draft`; `DAY_CAP_REACHED` with `details.scope` when `check_day_cap` refuses; each writes no run, job or audit row; `generation_failed` and `in_review` are allowed (WF-13) — verify: `candidate-service.test.ts::refusals_write_nothing` (fake ledger and queue) — evidence: 5 refusals/allowances asserted, counts unchanged — covers: GR-7, CON-G2, M-29
- [ ] AC-4 [invariant] the candidate's cap is one lesson's worst case from `max_call_cost` (draft 32,000 + truncation retry 48,000 + one repair at the pinned price), passed to `check_day_cap`, and the original run's `cap_usd` and spend are untouched — verify: `candidate-service.test.ts::own_cap_not_run_cap` — evidence: amount equals the formula; parent run row unchanged — covers: R-16, M-29
- [ ] AC-5 [invariant] `get` returns `queued` → `drafting` → `ready` as the job and version rows change, `sections` only when ready, and a failed job as `status failed` with `failure_reasons` and no error; a candidate id of another lesson → `NOT_FOUND` — verify: `candidate-service.test.ts::get_status_progression` — evidence: 4 reads — covers: R-29, CON-16
- [ ] AC-6 [invariant] `adopt whole` on a `ready` candidate sends one `apply_edit(AdoptEdit)` with tag `candidate-adopt` and the reviewer as actor, marks the candidate adopted, writes one `audit_event` and returns the new `content_hash` and `last_editor`; `adopt section` needs a `section_address` (else 400); a second whole adopt or a non-`ready` candidate → `INVALID_TRANSITION` (409) with no call — verify: `candidate-service.test.ts::adopt_paths` (recording double; `mark_adopted` per DO-4 §13 R-5; a section adopt leaves `adopted` false) — evidence: 1 call, row + event; 0 calls on refusal — covers: R-29, CON-G3, CON-G4, GR-7
- [ ] AC-7 [failure/refusal] `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` on adopt leaves the candidate unadopted and writes no audit row; an author → `ROLE_FORBIDDEN` on regenerate and adopt, but may `get` a guidance-trial candidate — verify: `candidate-service.test.ts::collab_down_and_roles` and the route test for 503, 403 — evidence: statuses; counts unchanged — covers: CON-G1, CON-G3, CON-16
- [ ] AC-8 [capture] driving `regenerateLesson` on the stub queue and then `adoptCandidate` at the real routes leaves the run, job, candidate version ("not adopted", number n+1), the unchanged current hash until adoption, and the adopt edit's audit event (WF-13) — verify: `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/candidates/route.test.ts::test_candidate_capture` — evidence: sequence of hashes and rows as listed — covers: OBS-1, OBS-2, GR-8, M-11, M-28
- [ ] AC-9 [regression/context] area map row(s) for this ticket's paths planned → actual (A12 rows `candidate-service.ts`, `app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/candidates/**`); router/ICM row if a route's evidence changed; dev-log entry (Changed · Why · Checked · Remaining) — verify: `git diff --stat` and `python3 ~/.claude/skills/icm-project/scripts/check_context.py .` — evidence: diff touches only those rows; no FAIL — covers: —

## [NL-48] metrics: heartbeats, merged sessions across tabs, frozen first-approval metrics row, board rows (pure + repo + services)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-15 / US-30 — As the person judging whether the tool cut reviewer time, I need review time measured honestly: active minutes only, one person in two tabs counted once, synthetic accounts excluded, and one frozen row per lesson at its first approval, never shown by name. This is the north-star data (M-1) and its guard (M-3, G-2).

### What to build
Four pieces, all in area A13:
**1. Pure core** — `packages/core/src/metrics/sessions.ts` `merge_heartbeats(beats, gap_s) → ActiveInterval[]` (per user, across tabs: consecutive active beats within `gap_s` join; beats closer than 10 s from one tab add no time; synthetic beats carry `synthetic` through) and `packages/core/src/metrics/frozen-row.ts` `compute_lesson_metrics(sessions, version, rating, approved_at) → LessonMetricsRecord` (human sessions only; `active_minutes` = Σ `active_seconds`/60; `human_sessions`; `teacher_word_count` from the version; `g2_threshold_minutes = 0.5 × (teacher_word_count ÷ 250)`, M-3).
**2. Repository** — `PgMetricsRepo` in `packages/db/src/repos/metrics.ts` (`insert_heartbeat`, `extend_session(hb, gap_s)` — one `review_session` per user, lesson and version: an active beat within `gap_s` of `last_at` adds `min(at − last_at, gap_s)` seconds, a second tab inside the same span adds only what extends it, an inactive beat adds 0; `sessions_for`, `first_approval_exists(lesson_id, tx)`, `write_lesson_metrics(row, tx)` as `INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` returning whether it wrote, `unit_metrics_rows`). `PgBoardReadRepo.board_rows(unit_id, state | null)` → `BoardRowRecord[]` (number, type, title, state, reviewer name, last change time, `dependency_flag`) is in this file too and is written here (DO-4 §3.5, DO-3 §4 A13a; §13 R-9): read-only over `lesson`, `app_user`, `review_event` and `lesson_link`, no minutes column and no person-level metric (GR-15); NL-54 imports it.
**3. Services** — `apps/web/src/server/services/heartbeat-service.ts` `HeartbeatService.record(user, lesson_id, hb)` (authors → `ROLE_FORBIDDEN`; unknown lesson → `NOT_FOUND`; active = focused ∧ visible ∧ `sent_at − last_input_at ≤ HEARTBEAT_MERGE_GAP_S` (60, allowed 60–90); a beat under `HEARTBEAT_MIN_SPACING_S` (10) from the same tab is stored but adds no time (CON-20; DO-4 §5 `HeartbeatService`, §13 R-7); `synthetic` copied from the account) and `metrics-writer.ts` `MetricsWriter.write_first_approval(lesson_id, version, rating, tx) → MetricsWriteResult` (`written: false` and no change when a row exists: rework never edits the first row).
**4. Route** — `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/heartbeats/route.ts` (`sendHeartbeat`, roles reviewer and approver, 204 empty body). `wiring/metrics.ts` is filled by NL-54, not here.
Must not: return minutes with a person's name from any route (CON-G8, GR-15), count author or synthetic sessions, edit a stored `lesson_metrics` row, or fill `wiring/metrics.ts`.

### Sources
- DO-4 §3.5 (`HeartbeatRecord`, `ReviewSessionRow`, `LessonMetricsRecord`, `MetricsRepo`, `PgMetricsRepo`), §5 (`HeartbeatService`, `MetricsWriter`, `MetricsWriteResult`), §8 *metrics* (`ActiveInterval`, `merge_heartbeats`, `compute_lesson_metrics`); DO-3 §2.1 (`metrics/*.ts`), §2.2 (`repos/metrics.ts`), §2.3, §4 A13a/A13b, §6 (`heartbeat`, `review_session`, `lesson_metrics`), §7 `HEARTBEAT_MERGE_GAP_S`, `HEARTBEAT_MIN_SPACING_S`
- CON-20 (agreed: roles, activity rule, 10 s spacing, no name with minutes, disclosure line); CON-10 (G-2 threshold stored per row); INTERFACE shared guarantees 1, 2, 8, 11; PRD R-49, R-60, GR-15; HP-8
- DO-6 WF-16 (`test_heartbeat_capture`), DO-5 S8; DO-7 M-1, M-3, M-12, M-43; slice plan *Collision map* W3 (heartbeats NL-48) and W4 (`wiring/metrics.ts` NL-54)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`

`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-36 — As the builder who must show the tool works, I need one runner that executes a named suite, stores one result per case with its source, and writes a report naming the code version, so later tickets only fill suites. Platform work: S1…S14 and the load scripts hang on this.

### What to build
**1. Evidence repository** — `PgEvidenceRepo` in `packages/db/src/repos/evidence.ts` (DO-4 §3.5): `start_eval_run(NewEvalRun)`, `add_case_result`, `finish_eval_run(id, passed, total, report_path)`, `insert_probe_run`, `insert_experiment_run`, `ops_event`, over `eval_run`, `eval_case_result`, `probe_run`, `experiment_run`, `ops_event` (NL-08's tables).
**2. Runner** — `evals/src/runner.ts` `EvalRunner(evidence, suites, clock).run(suite, opts) → EvalRunSummary` (DO-4 §9): starts an `eval_run` (suite, `git_sha`, `prompt_version_id`, models, `provider_mode`, `case_set`), scores each `EvalCase` through `EvalSuite.score`, stores one `eval_case_result` per case (provenance, source, guards, expected, actual, failure category), finishes with `passed`/`total`, writes `evals/reports/<kind>-<git-sha>.md` (kind `golden` for S1/S2/S3/S7, `grounding` for S4, `faults`, `full-run`, …) naming git SHA, prompt version, model ids and *n* (EV-R1).
**3. CLI** — `evals/src/cli.ts` behind the root scripts: `npm run eval:golden -- --suite intake,checks|drafts|safety [--repeat n] [--provider stub|real]`, `eval:grounding` (S4), `eval:faults` (S6), `eval:full-run`, `eval:seed`, `eval:heldout`, `eval:judge-calibrate`, `load:spike` mapped to suites per DO-3 §9; suite names `intake`→S1, `checks`→S2, `drafts`→S3, `safety`→S7. Exit code non-zero on any failed case in a suite whose acceptance floor is 1.00, and **non-zero for a suite with zero cases** (a shell must never report green).
**4. Shells** — `evals/src/suites/s1.ts … s14.ts`, each an `EvalSuite{name, cases() → [], score → throws NotImplemented}` registered in the runner; and `load/spike.ts` (`run_spike`), `load/http-mix.ts`, `load/yjs-mix.ts` exporting their DO-4 §9 signatures and throwing `NotImplemented` naming the filling ticket. Later tickets fill: s1, s7 NL-84 · s2, s4 NL-85 · s9, s13 NL-86 · s6 NL-107 · s3 NL-109 · s10 NL-92 · s12 NL-111 · s5 NL-125 · s8 NL-127 · s14 NL-118/119 (collision map W4–W7); this ticket never edits a suite body.
Must not: call a model or the network, store a provider key or a restricted-folder path in a report, write DDL, or edit another ticket's suite file once it is filled.

### Sources

## [NL-50] assist: request and decide an AI rewrite suggestion

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-23 — As a reviewer I select a passage, add a note and get a tracked rewrite suggestion held outside the lesson; nothing AI-written enters the lesson until I accept it, and an accepted change is attributed to me and tagged `ai-assist`. Cuttable (PD-17 #8): if the cut fires, the service is dropped and `wiring/assist.ts` stays a stub.

### What to build
Implement `SuggestionService` in `apps/web/src/server/services/suggestion-service.ts` (DO-4 §5) and routes `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/suggestions/route.ts` (`listSuggestions` GET, `requestSuggestion` POST → 201) and `…/suggestions/[suggestionId]/decision/route.ts` (`decideSuggestion`), role `reviewer` for the writes.
**`request`**: precedence role → lesson `NOT_FOUND` → `LESSON_LOCKED` (not editable; assist is never offered on approved lessons, GR-7) → render `PromptRenderer.render_assist(AssistPromptInput{prompt: PromptRepo.current, selected_text, note, section_name})` (only the selected text, the note and that lesson's context reach the model; the text is delimited data, never instructions) → `PaidCaller.call` (alias `ASSIST`, `run_id` null, `user_id` the reviewer, timeout `ASSIST_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS` = 20 s) → `SuggestionRepo.insert` with `expires_at = now + SUGGESTION_TTL_MIN` (30) and the `model_call_id` → `AuditLog.append` (`suggestion.request`) in one tx. `SpendRefused` and `ProviderError` both surface as `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` (503; `details.reason` `spend_cap` for the first) with nothing stored. `selected_text` over 2,000 characters → `INVALID_REQUEST`.
**`decide`**: not `pending` (accepted, rejected, closed or expired) → `INVALID_TRANSITION` (409). `accept` → `CollabCommands.apply_edit(EditCommand{edit: SuggestionAcceptEdit{suggestion_id, anchor, expected_text = the STORED selected_text, replacement_text = suggested_text}, tag "ai-assist", actor = the acceptor})`; the collaboration server resolves the anchor against the live document and applies only if the text there equals `expected_text`; the browser's `anchored_text_now` is a hint and is never used for the check. `ANCHOR_CHANGED` → `decide(closed)` and 409; `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` → suggestion stays `pending`. Success → `decide(accepted)` + audit (`suggestion.accept`) and the new `content_hash`. `reject` → `decide(rejected)` + audit. `list_pending` excludes expired (a pending suggestion blocks Submit and Approve — NL-39's `suggestion_pending` rule reads it). `section_name` is resolved from the stored derived row through the constructor's `reader: LessonDocReader` (DO-4 §5 `SuggestionService`, §13 R-6); `NewSuggestion.expires_at = now + SUGGESTION_TTL_MIN` is set here (§13 R-3).
Must not: write lesson content from the web process (CON-G3), accept a suggestion by the browser's text, send student work or other lessons' text to the model, log `selected_text`, `suggested_text` or the prompt outside `model_call`, edit `wiring/assist.ts` (NL-116) or another route folder.

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 (`SuggestionService`), §4 (`PromptRenderer.render_assist`, `AssistPromptInput`, `PaidCaller`, `PaidCallRequest`), §3.3 (`SuggestionAcceptEdit`, `EditCommand`), §3.5 (`SuggestionRepo`, `SuggestionRow`, `AuditLog`), §10.2 (`SpendRefused`, `ProviderError`); DO-3 §2.3 (`suggestion-service.ts`), §4 A15, §7 `ASSIST_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS`, `SUGGESTION_TTL_MIN`
- CON-17 (agreed: errors, 30 min expiry, accept applied server-side against the live document, pending blocks Submit and Approve, request timeout 20 s); INTERFACE shared guarantees 2, 3, 11; PRD R-31 (§5.4), cut #8; GR-7, GR-1, GR-9
- WP-1 (a selection in L4 Part A as the example); DO-6 WF-14 (`test_ai_assist_capture`, written only if the item lands); slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`suggestions/**` NL-50) and wiring owner (`wiring/assist.ts` NL-116)
- **Brief check:** serves "Have a UI/UX for reviewing and editing/updating a lesson's content in the system (wysiwyg), and AI assisted tooling as helpful."; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] `request` on WP-1 L4 with a 12-word selection and a note calls `PaidCaller.call` once with alias `ASSIST`, `run_id` null and the reviewer as `user_id`, stores one `pending` suggestion with `expires_at = now + 30 min` and the `model_call_id`, writes one `audit_event`, and returns 201 (WF-14) — verify: ``apps/web/src/server/services/suggestion-service.test.ts::request_stores_pending` (stub `PaidCaller`, FakeClock) — evidence: row + event; expiry exact — covers: R-31, GR-7, M-10
- [ ] AC-2 [failure/refusal] a `SpendRefused` and a `ProviderError`/20 s timeout each return `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` (503; first with `details.reason "spend_cap"`), store no suggestion and write no audit row; a locked or `approved` lesson → `LESSON_LOCKED` with no model call; an author → `ROLE_FORBIDDEN` — verify: `suggestion-service.test.ts::request_refusals_write_nothing` — evidence: calls and rows as stated — covers: CON-G1, CON-G2, GR-7, CON-17
- [ ] AC-3 [negative] the accept path ignores the browser's `anchored_text_now`: with a stored `selected_text` of A, a client hint of B and the collaboration double answering `ANCHOR_CHANGED`, the call sent `expected_text = A` and the suggestion is closed with 409; with a matching live text it is accepted — verify: `suggestion-service.test.ts::accept_uses_stored_text_not_client_hint` — evidence: recorded `expected_text` == A in both — covers: R-31, CON-G3

## [NL-51] export: idempotent export of approved snapshots (dependants only when their sources are approved)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-35 / US-28 — As an approver I export a unit's approved lessons as a versioned JSON file in the published schema, and exporting twice with no change gives the same file, so Newsela can import what was approved and nothing else. Cuttable (PD-17 #5): if the cut fires the service is dropped and `wiring/exports.ts` stays a stub.

### What to build
Implement `ExportService` in `apps/web/src/server/services/export-service.ts` (DO-4 §5) and routes `apps/web/app/api/units/[unitId]/exports/route.ts` (`listExports` GET; `createExport` POST → 200 same or 201 new) and `apps/web/app/api/exports/[exportId]/download/route.ts` (`downloadExport`), role `approver` only. `wiring/exports.ts` is NL-102's.
**`list`**: `included[{lesson_id, approved_hash}]` from `LessonVersionRepo.approved_snapshots(unit_id)` filtered so a **dependent lesson is included only while every lesson it links to is approved** (`LessonGraphRepo`); `held_back[{lesson_id, reason, waits_on}]` (e.g. "Lesson 4 waits on Lesson 5"); `exports[{export_id, version_number, created_at, created_by, lesson_count, payload_hash}]` from `ExportRepo.all_for_unit`.
**`create`**: one `TxRunner.with_tx` under `pg_advisory_xact_lock('export:' || unit_id)` (two simultaneous calls serialize; the second sees the first's result): build the payload (`ExportBundleFile` from `packages/schema/src/export.ts`: approved snapshots' lesson JSON and hashes only, canonical key order) → `payload_sha256`; if equal to `ExportRepo.latest(unit_id).payload_sha256` return that export with `same_as_previous: true` (200) and write **nothing** (no row, no state change, no audit row); else `ExportRepo.insert` (next `version_number`, `lesson_versions`, `held_back`), move each newly included lesson to `exported` (`LessonStateRepo.set_state`; an `exported` lesson stays in later exports while its approved snapshot stands) and `AuditLog.append` (`export.create`), 201. The constructor's `states: LessonStateRepo` makes that move (DO-4 §5 `ExportService`, §13 R-6; CON-23 moves lessons to `exported` in the same transaction). The `approved → exported` move writes one `review_event` per newly exported lesson (actor = the caller), in the same transaction (DO-3 §6: every lesson move goes there; DO-4 §5 `ExportService`, §13 R-6).
**`download`**: `ExportRepo.payload(export_id)` → the JSON document; unknown id → `NOT_FOUND`. The payload must validate against `docs/contracts/lesson-export.schema.json` (emitted by NL-09's `npm run schemas:emit`; this ticket does not write that file).
Must not: read a draft, derived row, candidate or non-approved snapshot; include prompts, raw model output, provenance model fields beyond what the schema lists, emails, review notes or minutes; call the network.

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 (`ExportService`), §3.5 (`NewExportBundle`, `HeldBackRecord`, `ExportBundleRow`, `ExportRepo`, `LessonVersionRepo.approved_snapshots`, `LessonGraphRepo`), §9 schema emitter; DO-3 §2.3 (`export-service.ts`), §4 A17, §6 (`export_bundle`)
- CON-23 (agreed: approved snapshots only, dependants rule, idempotent, per-unit serialisation, `exported` in the same transaction, 200 vs 201); INTERFACE shared guarantees 1, 2, 11; PRD R-42 (§5.4), cut #5; HP-4, HP-5 addendum; PD-22 ("Export (no live integration)")
- WP-1 (L4 depends on L5's slot: held back until L5 is approved); DO-6 WF-19 (`test_export_capture`, written only if the item lands); slice plan *Collision map* W3 (`units/[unitId]/exports/**`, `exports/**` NL-51) and wiring owner (`wiring/exports.ts` NL-102)
- **Brief check:** serves "Import the generated lesson content into a system for persistence and tracking, so that next steps of editing, approval, finalization can take place, and ultimately published to our application."; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] with L5 approved and L4 (which links to L5) approved, `create` includes both; with L5 `in_review`, L4 is `held_back` with `waits_on L5` and absent from `included` and from the payload; approving L5 and exporting again includes L4 (WF-19) — verify: ``apps/web/src/server/services/export-service.test.ts::dependants_only_when_sources_approved` (WP-1 pair, in-memory ports) — evidence: three payload member lists — covers: R-42, R-34, CON-23
- [ ] AC-2 [negative] only approved snapshots are exported: an `in_review`, `submitted`, `changes_requested` or `reopened` lesson that has an older `approve` snapshot, a candidate, and a lesson's newer derived row never appear in `included` or in the payload — verify: `export-service.test.ts::approved_snapshots_only` — evidence: payload ids equal the approved set exactly — covers: R-42, GR-6, M-36
- [ ] AC-3 [invariant] exporting twice with no change: the second call returns the first export (200, `same_as_previous true`, the same `export_id`, `payload_hash` and `version_number`) and writes no `export_bundle`, no state change and no audit row; after one approved lesson changes, a new version is written (201) with `version_number` + 1 (WF-19) — verify: `export-service.test.ts::idempotent_and_new_version` — evidence: row counts 1 then 2 — covers: R-42, M-36

- [ ] AC-5 [invariant] newly included lessons move to `exported` in the same transaction as the insert (a failing insert leaves every state unchanged); an already `exported` lesson stays in later exports while its snapshot stands — verify: `export-service.test.ts::exported_state_same_tx` (fault-injected insert) — evidence: states before == after on fault; `exported` retained — covers: R-33, R-42, CON-G2

- [ ] AC-8 [capture] driving `createExport` twice at its real route with no change leaves one `export_bundle` row naming only approved version ids and their hashes, one `audit_event`, and identical payload hashes (WF-19) — verify: `…/exports/route.test.ts::test_export_capture` — evidence: counts 1/1; hashes equal; hashes equal the approved snapshot hashes — covers: OBS-1, M-36, CON-G4
- [ ] AC-9 [regression/context] area map row(s) for this ticket's paths planned → actual (A17 rows `export-service.ts`, `db/src/repos/exports.ts`, `app/api/units/[unitId]/exports/**`, `app/api/exports/**`); router/ICM row if a route's evidence changed; dev-log entry (Changed · Why · Checked · Remaining) — verify: `git diff --stat` and `python3 ~/.claude/skills/icm-project/scripts/check_context.py .` — evidence: diff touches only those rows; no FAIL — covers: —

## [NL-53] review: lesson transitions with every gate re-checked on the server (pin, four-eyes, rating, dependency order, Submit/unfreeze via collab); fills review-area wiring

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-24 — As a reviewer I submit a lesson when nothing is blocking, to freeze it, so that the approver reads exactly what I sent. US-25 — As an approver I approve one pinned version on its evidence, so that "approved" means a named person approved exactly that text. US-26/27/28/31 — send back with a reason, approve linked lessons in order, reopen without breaking dependants, rate the draft at Approve.

### What to build
Implement the server side of every lesson move and the approval gate, and fill the review wiring so all six review-area services are real objects.

- `apps/web/src/server/services/transition-service.ts` — `TransitionService.transition(user, lesson_id, req)` (DO-4 §5). Precedence (CON-18): `transition_roles(action)` (`ROLE_FORBIDDEN`) → `LessonStateRepo.get` (`NOT_FOUND`) → `decide_transition(action, role, from_state, note, reason, tag, rating)` (`INVALID_TRANSITION`, then `NOTE_REQUIRED` / `REASON_REQUIRED` / `RATING_REQUIRED`) → per action: `start_review` (one tx: `set_state(in_review, reviewer)` + `review_event`); `submit` → `CollabCommands.lock_and_snapshot` (NL-106 does the freeze; its refusals `NOT_STORED`, `BLOCKED`, `CONFIRMATION_OPEN`, `SUGGESTION_PENDING` pass through with the same code and `details`; unreachable → `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing changed); `approve` → `ApproveService.approve`; `withdraw` / `request_changes` / `reopen` → one tx with the lesson row locked (reopen writes a new `lesson_version` with `derived_from_version_id`) → `CollabCommands.set_mode(editable)` **inside the open tx** → commit (DO-4 §5 `TransitionService`, §13 R-10). `CollabUnavailable` → rollback → `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` (503), nothing changed (CON-18). If the commit itself fails after `set_mode` succeeded: best-effort `set_mode(read_only, from_state)`, one `InvariantViolation` log line, then the error envelope (a collab restart re-seeds `FrozenDocs` from the stored state). The `review_event` id is the response's `audit_id`.
- `apps/web/src/server/services/approve-service.ts` — `ApproveService.approve` (**the approval-integrity code**): one tx with the lesson row locked (`lock_for_update`): `decide_transition` re-checked on the locked row → `LessonVersionRepo.latest_snapshot` (kind `submit`) and the pin (`snapshot_hash` AND `snapshot_state_vector`) else `STALE_PIN` → `CheckContextLoader.load(snapshot.lesson, snapshot.content_hash)` + `run_checks(CHECK_RULES, policy)` on the **snapshot** → `merge_resolutions(findings, IssueRepo.resolutions_for(lesson_id))` → `GateState{pending_check false, pending_suggestions, open_confirmations, last_editor_id, approver_id, four_eyes_enabled, dependencies}` → `approve_gate` in order `FOUR_EYES → SUGGESTION_PENDING → BLOCKED → CONFIRMATION_OPEN → DEPENDENCY_UNAPPROVED` → `write_snapshot(kind approve, dependency_record)` + `set_state(approved)` + `append_review_event` + `MetricsWriter.write_first_approval` → commit. No collaboration hop (already frozen). A refused call rolls back and writes **no row of any kind**; one log line only.
- `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/transitions/route.ts` through `with_route` with `RouteSpec.request_schema = "TransitionRequestInput"` (NL-11's Zod mirror, DO-4 §5: `rating`, `note`, `reason` optional so the card's codes are reachable; do not edit it).
- `apps/web/src/server/wiring/review.ts` — `wire_review` fills `ReviewWiring {lesson_reads, issues, slots, candidates, transitions, approvals}` from `WebDeps` with the real `Pg*` repositories, `HttpCollabCommandClient`, `CheckContextLoader`, `CHECK_RULES`, `CHECK_POLICY`, `MetricsWriter`, `FOUR_EYES_ENABLED`.

**Must not:** let any role approve its own submit when `FOUR_EYES_ENABLED`; approve without a matching pin; trust the client's view of blocking issues; write content (only the collaboration server writes content); bulk anything (one lesson per call, GR-6); edit `packages/core/src/{lifecycle,checks}/**` or the collab server. Settled (DO-4 §13 R-10): `set_mode` runs inside the transaction, so a collaboration failure rolls the move back, as CON-18 promises.

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 `TransitionService`, `ApproveService`, `TransitionRequestInput`, §3.3 `CollabCommands`, §3.5 `LessonStateRepo`, `LessonVersionRepo`, `LessonGraphRepo`, §8 *checks* (`run_checks`, `merge_resolutions`, `approve_gate`, `GateState`) and *lifecycle* (`decide_transition`, `transition_roles`), §10.1, §12 `wire_review`; DO-3 §2.3, §6 (`lesson_version`, `review_event`, `lesson_metrics`).
- CON-18 (agreed, full precedence), shared guarantees 1, 2, 7, 11; OpenAPI `transitionLesson`, `TransitionRequest`, `TransitionResult`; the filed dry run `docs/design/spec-dry-run.md` Part 2 T2 is the depth model.
- PRD R-33, R-34, R-35, R-60, GR-6; HP-5 (approval integrity), HP-8; PD-7, PD-10 (four-eyes on); UXP-1, UXP-2, UXP-4, UXP-6, UXP-10; WP-1, WP-4 (safety flag open blocks Approve).
- **Brief check:** serves "server-enforced lesson state machine by role … Approve pins the snapshot … no bulk approve" and a named human approving; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [failure/refusal] Given a `submitted` lesson and a signed-in reviewer, when `POST /lessons/G6.U4.L5/transitions` carries a valid `Approve` body, then 403 `ROLE_FORBIDDEN` and the `lesson_version`, `review_event`, `lesson_metrics` row counts are unchanged (WF-15) — verify: `apps/web/app/api/lessons/[lessonId]/transitions/route.test.ts::approve_by_reviewer_forbidden` — evidence: response; unchanged counts — covers: R-33, CON-18, CON-G1, CON-G2, R-54
- [ ] AC-2 [failure/refusal] When the lesson id does not exist then 404 `NOT_FOUND`; when an approver approves a lesson in `in_review`, or a second approver approves an already `approved` lesson, then 409 `INVALID_TRANSITION` (WF-15) — verify: `route.test.ts::unknown_and_wrong_state` — evidence: three responses — covers: CON-18, R-33
- [ ] AC-3 [failure/refusal] When an approver approves without `rating`, then 422 `RATING_REQUIRED` (ranked after `INVALID_TRANSITION`, before `STALE_PIN`); request-changes with an empty note gives `NOTE_REQUIRED`; reopen without a reason gives `REASON_REQUIRED`; each writes no row (WF-15) — verify: `route.test.ts::missing_input_codes_before_pin` — evidence: three responses; unchanged counts — covers: R-60, CON-18, CON-G11
- [ ] AC-4 [failure/refusal] Given a latest `submit` snapshot with hash H, when approve is posted with `snapshot_hash` ≠ H, or with H and a different `snapshot_state_vector`, then 409 `STALE_PIN` with `details.request_id` and `lesson.state` still `submitted` (WF-15) — verify: `route.test.ts::stale_hash_and_stale_vector_refused` — evidence: two responses; unchanged rows — covers: R-33, HP-5, GR-6, CON-18
- [ ] AC-5 [failure/refusal] Given both a stale pin and a four-eyes breach, then the code is `STALE_PIN` (CON-18 precedence); given a matching pin and `FOUR_EYES_ENABLED = true` with `lesson.last_editor_id == approver`, then 422 `FOUR_EYES`; with the setting false the same call is not refused for that reason (WF-15) — verify: `route.test.ts::precedence_and_four_eyes_toggle` — evidence: three responses — covers: R-33, CON-18, M-37

## [NL-54] metrics: unit board and unit metrics from stored rows, aggregate only; fills metrics-area wiring

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-11 — As an author or reviewer I need to know which lesson to review next, so that I spend my time where a lesson is furthest from approvable. US-12 — I see that a lesson depends on another. US-30 — I see reviewer time per approved lesson honestly: with its n, the fast-approval guard, "approved k of N" and the caption, never by person.

### What to build
Write `BoardService` and fill the metrics wiring. `HeartbeatService`, `MetricsWriter`, the pure metrics code and `PgMetricsRepo` / `PgBoardReadRepo` are NL-48's (wave 3); this ticket reads them and owns:

- `apps/web/src/server/services/board-service.ts`: `board(user, unit_id, state?) -> UnitBoard` (CON-9) and `metrics(user, unit_id) -> UnitMetrics` (CON-10).
  - **Board:** `BoardReadRepo.board_rows(unit_id, state)` + `IssueRepo.counts_by_lesson(unit_id)`. Counts come from the stored `issue` rows of each lesson's latest *checked* hash; it never calls `run_checks`. `rollup` counts every lesson state over the whole unit even when `state` filters the rows. **Sort (UXQ-5):** `generation_failed` first as a group; then active lessons by `blocking_count` desc, `advisory_count` desc, `confirmation_count` desc, lesson order; `approved` and `exported` last in lesson order. `reviewer` is the reviewer who started the review (UXP-1); `send_back` (`tag`, `note`) from the latest `request_changes` `review_event`; `dependency_flags` from `lesson_link` rows: `waits_on` with status `slot_empty` or `waiting_for_source_approval` (UXP-2) and `source_reopened`. `judge_flag` is omitted until NL-110 supplies verdicts.
  - **Metrics:** `MetricsRepo.unit_metrics_rows(unit_id)` (frozen first-approval rows only) → `north_star`: `median_minutes` (empty when n = 0), `n`, `fast_approvals {count, of}` where a row counts when `active_minutes < g2_threshold_minutes` (the row's own stored threshold), `approved {k, total}`, the exact caption `No baseline yet (AQ-14). Measured with us as reviewers.`, `segment_label` such as `one reviewer, n = 3` when fewer than 3 distinct reviewers (GR-15). `quality` is the key present with value `null` while cut #6 is cut. Output never contains a person's name next to minutes.
- Routes `apps/web/app/api/units/[unitId]/board/route.ts` (GET, optional `state`) and `.../metrics/route.ts` (GET) through `with_route`; every role reads.
- `apps/web/src/server/wiring/metrics.ts` (`wire_metrics`, DO-4 §12): builds `BoardService`, `HeartbeatService` (NL-48's class, wired here) and `MetricsWriter` (consumed by NL-53 through `WebDeps`/review wiring) from `PgMetricsRepo`, `PgBoardReadRepo`, `PgIssueRepo`, settings; `MetricsWiring {board, heartbeats}`.

**Must not:** recompute a metric with a model or from live checks; return minutes joined to a name (GR-15, shared guarantee 8); edit NL-48's pure code or repos; add `coverage` (NL-91 adds one method later in this file; keep the class open for it).

### Sources
- DO-4 §5 `BoardService`, `HeartbeatService`, `MetricsWriter`, §3.5 `BoardReadRepo`, `MetricsRepo`, `IssueRepo.counts_by_lesson`, §8 *metrics* (`merge_heartbeats`, `compute_lesson_metrics`), §12 `wire_metrics`; DO-3 §6 (`lesson_metrics`, `review_session`).
- CON-9, CON-10 (agreed), CON-20 (the heartbeat route NL-48 owns; this ticket wires its service); OpenAPI `getUnitBoard`, `getUnitMetrics`.
- PRD R-25, R-49, R-60, GR-15; HP-8 (honest minutes); UXP-1, UXP-2, UXP-6, UXQ-5, UXQ-7; WP-1 (a seeded unit with row 8 lessons in mixed states).
- **Brief check:** serves "a triage queue / unit board" and the reviewer-time north star measured honestly; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing (aggregate only) → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] Given a seeded unit with lessons in every state, when `GET /units/{id}/board`, then rows are ordered `generation_failed` first, then active lessons by blocking desc, advisory desc, confirmation desc, lesson order, then `approved` / `exported` in lesson order (WF-7) — verify: `apps/web/app/api/units/[unitId]/board/route.test.ts::sort_order_uxq5` — evidence: ordered `lesson_id` list — covers: R-25, CON-9
- [ ] AC-2 [invariant] When the board is filtered with `state=in_review`, then `rows` hold only those lessons while `rollup` still counts the whole unit and its counts sum to the number of lessons (WF-7) — verify: `board/route.test.ts::filter_keeps_whole_unit_rollup` — evidence: rollup sum equals lesson count — covers: R-25, CON-9
- [ ] AC-3 [invariant] Given stored issue rows on the latest checked hash and a newer unchecked hash, when the board is read, then counts equal the stored rows and `run_checks` is never called (spy) (WF-7) — verify: `board/route.test.ts::counts_from_stored_issue_rows` — evidence: counts; spy 0 calls — covers: R-28, CON-9, CON-G5
- [ ] AC-4 [invariant] Given Lesson 5 linked from Lesson 4 with an empty slot, then Lesson 5's row has `waits_on` / `slot_empty`; once the slot is filled and Lesson 4 is unapproved it reads `waiting_for_source_approval`; a reopened source adds `source_reopened` and nothing changes state by itself (WF-7) — verify: `board/route.test.ts::dependency_flags_uxp2` — evidence: three responses — covers: R-34, CON-9
- [ ] AC-5 [invariant] `reviewer` is the reviewer who started the review, `send_back` carries the latest tag and note, and `judge_flag` is absent when no verdict rows exist — verify: `board/route.test.ts::reviewer_send_back_no_judge_flag` — evidence: response — covers: CON-9, R-23

### Story
US-1 / US-2 — As an outline author (P-2), I need to upload the unit outline as CSV or XLSX, or paste a public Google Sheet link, and get a fixed, numbered version, so that every later step points at one known input.

### What to build

File: a drop zone that is a labelled button with **Choose file** (dragging is never the only way), "CSV or XLSX, up to 200 rows". Link: a **Google Sheet link** URL field and the helper "The sheet must be shared so anyone with the link can view it." Primary **Upload** / **Import**.
- Calls `uploadOutline` (multipart) or `importOutlineLink` (CON-2). On success shows the summary line from the response ("Grade 6 · Unit 4 · version 1 · 41 lessons · 6 flex days · 7 arc headers · 1 total row") then navigates to SCR-4 for that version; a repeated hash shows "Version 2 is the same as version 1; 0 lessons changed." with a link to the report.
- Trim (a) (PRD §6.5): the link import is the first thing cut; the segmented control then disappears (one flag in `src/features/upload-outline/`).
- Must not: parse the file in the browser beyond the extension check, or store anything on an error.

### Story
US-3 — As an outline author (P-2), I need every row marked OK, warning or error, with the original cell and a proposed fix, so that I fix the outline before any money is spent (with US-4 cell kinds and US-5 ELD re-maps).

### What to build
- `app/(app)/units/[unitKey]/outlines/[version]/page.tsx` + `src/features/validation-report/**`, layout per SCR-4 (two-pane, `rail-narrow` 288; breadcrumb *Units › Grade 6 · Unit 4 › Validation report*): header with file chip, uploader, version chip and short hash; **Errors** table (count badge, where, the original cell as a code chip + one sentence, the proposed fix, **Confirm** / **Edit**); **Warnings** dense table with each default as a segmented radio group (*Apply · Show to reviewer only · Ignore*; excerpt slot; unit rule; *Keep · Re-map* for ELD with the sheet label and official strand side by side; **Confirm as a safety flag**); OK rows collapsed ("Show 35 OK rows"); rail Summary card, the gate banner and **Generate 47 lessons**.
- Data: `getValidationReport` (CON-3); each choice → `recordIntakeChoice` (CON-4, incl. `revert` behind **Undo**); **Generate** opens NL-24's `StartRunDialog` shell (SCR-5, NL-58) with the version id. Inline **Edit** validates the code on blur against the standards list the report carries.
- **Every cell string is rendered as a React text node** (R-58, CON-G6): `<script>` shows as literal characters. Counts in the heading, banner and Summary update at once and announce politely.
- Must not: compute the gate in the browser beyond displaying `generate_allowed` and `errors_unconfirmed` from the response.

## [NL-61] web-ui: SCR-8 Unit board (sort, filters, north-star tile)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-11 — As a reviewer (P-1) I need to see which lesson to review next, sorted by what blocks, so my time goes where it matters; the same board shows dependency flags (US-12) and the north-star tile (US-30), the reviewer minutes per approved lesson, with its *n* and no baseline claimed.

### What to build
- `app/(app)/units/[unitKey]/board/page.tsx` + `src/features/board/**`: breadcrumb *Units › Grade 6 › Unit 4*; `h1` "Unit 4 · *The Lightning Thief*" with a count chip; the roll-up sheet (five state cells as filter buttons, plus a track bar whose text equivalent reads "Draft 34, In review 6, Submitted 2, Approved 3, Failed 2"); the north-star `metric-tile` ("Reviewer minutes per approved lesson", median, *n*, two guard tiles, the caption "No baseline yet (AQ-14). Measured with us as reviewers."); the segmented filter as a radio group "Filter lessons by state" (*Changes requested* and *Reopened* only when any exist); the board table (Lesson link, Type, State pill, Blocking, Advisory, Reviewer, Note) with `aria-sort` on Blocking; the links row (Run summary, Unit plan, and the nav-flagged Coverage, Unit quality, Export entries hidden when their cut fires, via NL-24's `nav.ts` flags).
- Data: `getUnitBoard` (CON-9: rows, roll-up, filter) polled with `use-poll.ts` (2 s, stale banner after > 10 s, focus never moved, polite announce only "Lesson 7 is ready" or a run-state change); `getUnitMetrics` (CON-10) fetched separately so a tile failure leaves the table up. Sort is the server's order (UXQ-5: blocking, then advisory, then lesson order; failed first, approved last); the screen never re-sorts.
- Row action by role (UXQ-6): reviewer click → SCR-9; approver click on a `submitted` row → SCR-14, any other row → SCR-9 read-only; a failed row's "Retry" links to SCR-6 (author only). Notes render the dependency flags ("Waits on Lesson 5's excerpt", "…approval", "A lesson this depends on was reopened"), send-back tag pill, and the judge note when present, all as text (R-58).
- Must not: show minutes per named person or rank reviewers (GR-15); compute any figure client-side; edit a lesson; add bulk actions.

### Sources
- SCR-8 (signed) in `docs/ux/03-structure/SCREEN_SPECS.md` and *Conventions every screen follows*; IA §3 address `/units/:unitKey/board`; UXP-2, UXQ-4, UXQ-5, UXQ-6, UXQ-7
- CON-9 (agreed: rows, roll-up, filter; `NOT_FOUND`), CON-10 (agreed: north-star numbers, `n` 0 when nothing approved); HP-3, HP-5, HP-8, HP-10; PRD R-25, R-49, GR-15; WP-1 (Lesson 4 row)
- DO-3 §2.3 `apps/web/app/(app)/**` (A14), §4 A14 row; FW components (`docs/design/design.md` §3–§4); NL-24's client, frame, `use-poll.ts`, test utilities
- **Brief check:** serves "Thoughtful design and easy to understand/use/navigate workflow"; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

### Acceptance criteria

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy

US-13 — As a reviewer (P-1) I need to read the draft in Newsela's own lesson shape, and (US-14) keep the evidence beside the text: issues, standards with their official text, and the confirmed outline row, so I can judge without opening another tab.

### What to build
- `app/(app)/units/[unitKey]/lessons/[lessonKey]/page.tsx` and the workspace shell in `src/features/workspace/**` **except** `actions/**`, `live/**` and `src/editor/**` (NL-64, NL-63): breadcrumb, stepper (Draft → In review → Submitted → Approved → Exported), outline column (`nav` "Lesson sections", minutes, blocking glyph, click moves to the section), the page sheet (lesson `h1`, meta, collapsed **Lesson details**, text card with ISBN and `off-platform-text`, sections with address labels, quote slots as text with their rights) and the evidence `aside` "Evidence" with tabs **Issues · Standards · Outline row**.
- Read view: render `getLesson` (CON-11) through `src/features/workspace/read-view/**` as semantic elements built from the compiled document nodes (allow-listed nodes only, headings in order, never `innerHTML`; R-58). The editor mount point `<LessonEditor readOnly … />` is NL-24's shell; this ticket passes `readOnly` from the lesson state and the role and renders the server text until NL-63 replaces the shell. Frozen, approved, reopened and `changes_requested` banners per SCR-9 *States*; role-forbidden note "You're viewing as an approver. Only reviewers edit lessons."

Checks re-running dims cards to `ink2` with "Checking…".
- States owned here: loading skeleton, `generation_failed` banner (with **Regenerate** shown by NL-64's bar), `SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` ("Lesson 4 won't open. It uses schema version 3, which this app doesn't know yet. Nothing has been dropped."), can't load, not found. Opening a draft as a reviewer calls NO transition here (UXP-1 start is NL-64's); author/approver opens never start review (UXQ-11).
- Must not: edit text, connect the socket (NL-63), send transitions or heartbeats (NL-64), or render any lesson string as HTML.

## [NL-63] web-ui: SCR-9 live editor (y-prosemirror + provider, presence, stored ack, reconnect, drops refused local edits and tells the typist)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-15 — As a reviewer (P-1) I need to edit the lesson together with colleagues and know my edits are stored, so nothing I type is lost and my time is counted fairly; when the lesson freezes under me, the editor must say plainly which of my edits were not kept (SP-2).

### What to build
- `apps/web/src/editor/**` (replaces NL-24's `LessonEditor({ lessonId, lesson, readOnly, onClientState })` shell, same props) and `src/features/workspace/live/**`: a ProseMirror editor with the Newsela node schema (allow-listed nodes only, R-58), `y-prosemirror` bound to a Yjs doc, and a Hocuspocus provider to `x-collaboration-channel` (CON-12; URL from the client config, session cookie). Toolbar strip (Paragraph, B, I, U, list, link, undo, redo), labelled textbox "Lesson 4 text", per-role marks from CON-11's compiled shape.
- Presence: remote carets with a name flag in the user's presence colour (name in text, not colour alone), initials on the outline item, and the top-bar sentence "M. Okafor is editing Part B" (real text, polite). Save state slot: `connecting` ("Connecting to the editor…" after 1 s; read-only CON-11 text meanwhile) → `synced` → `saving` ("Saving…") → `stored` ("Saved · 10:42", on the `stored {content_hash, state_vector, stored_at}` ack) → `DISCONNECTED`. `onClientState` reports `{ state, state_vector, stored }` for NL-64's Submit reasons ("Saving", `NOT_STORED`).
- `DISCONNECTED` (UXP-7): `warn` banner "Reconnecting: your last edits are not saved yet. Submit is off until they are.", save state "Not saved", typing continues locally, the provider reconnects with backoff and resyncs; on reconnect the held edits go up.
- Freeze (SP-2, CON-12 `refused`): on `mode {read_only, state}` the editor turns read-only (no toolbar, no caret). When the server answers a local update with `refused {code: LESSON_LOCKED, message, refused_from}` the editor **drops** the refused local edits (reverts to the stored state at `refused_from`, never re-sending them) and shows a `danger`-toned notice naming what was lost ("Your last edits were not saved because Lesson 4 was submitted. They have been removed from your view."), then stays read-only. Unauthenticated sockets are refused and show the signed-out flow.
- Must not: write the document through any REST route, retry a refused update, apply remote text as HTML, or keep a second copy of the document outside the Yjs doc. New dependencies (`prosemirror-*`, `y-prosemirror`, `yjs`, `@hocuspocus/provider`) go to the batch merge agent (A0).

### Sources
- SCR-9 (signed) *States* rows: Editing/saved, Co-editor present, `DISCONNECTED`, Frozen; UXP-7, UXQ-10; SP-2 record `docs/analysis/spikes/SP-2*.md` (freeze = server read-only flip + per-update guard; editor drops refused local edits and tells the typist)
- CON-12 (agreed: client states, `stored`, `mode`, `refused`/`refused_from`, `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `LESSON_LOCKED`, `DISCONNECTED`) and `x-collaboration-channel` in `docs/contracts/interface.openapi.yaml`; HP-2; PRD R-26, R-54, R-58; WP-1
- DO-3 §2.3 `src/editor/**`, §4 A14 row; DO-4 `apply_refusal` / `RefusedMessage` shapes (cite by name); NL-24's collab mock (`mocks/collab-mock.ts`, `/__mock/lock|unlock|drop`)
- **Brief check:** serves "Have a UI/UX for reviewing and editing/updating a lesson's content in the system (wysiwyg), and AI assisted tooling as helpful."; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

Okafor is editing Part B"; a typed edit moves the save state "Saving…" → "Saved · hh:mm" on the `stored` ack (≤ 2 s) — verify: `perl -e 'alarm 500; exec @ARGV' npx playwright test e2e/workspace-editor --grep collab` with `npm run mock:collab` running — evidence: pass; the save text asserted from the ack time — covers: SCR-9, CON-12, R-26

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-16/US-18/US-20 — As a reviewer (P-1) I need to confirm or remove a tool-chosen standard (with an undo), start and submit review, withdraw, and ask for a regenerated candidate, with every disabled button saying why; my active time is recorded by heartbeat and shown only as unit totals (US-14 disclosure).

### What to build
- `src/features/workspace/actions/**` (replaces NL-24's `WorkspaceActionBar({ lesson, issues, clientState })`) and `use-review-heartbeat.ts` (`useReviewHeartbeat({ lessonId, versionId })`); the issue-rail **Confirm** / **Remove** buttons for `narrowed`/`added` standards and **Resolve…** / **Clear flag…** openers (the dialogs are NL-66).
- Footer bar: the disclosure "Active review time on this lesson is recorded and shown only as unit totals."; the blocking count; primary **Submit for approval** with its reasons beneath, each on its own line from CON-11/13 + `clientState`: "3 blocking issues" (`BLOCKED`), "1 standard to confirm" (`CONFIRMATION_OPEN`), "Accept or reject the AI suggestion first" (`SUGGESTION_PENDING`), "Saving" (`NOT_STORED`); `aria-disabled` with the reason, and pressing it moves focus to the first issue. A server refusal shows the `danger` banner "Submit refused: `RL.6.2` has no checking item on the stored copy." and nothing freezes. The **More** menu: Regenerate (optional note popover → `regenerateLesson`; "Drafting a candidate… The current lesson is unchanged." and a link to SCR-12 when ready), History (→ SCR-16), AI assist (only when cut #8 stands).
- Transitions via `transitionLesson` (CON-18): `start_review` on a reviewer's first open of a draft (UXP-1; quiet line "You're the reviewer for this lesson."; never for author/approver, UXQ-11), `submit` with `client_state_vector` from `clientState`, `withdraw` (no reason, UXP-10; toast "Lesson 4 withdrawn. It's back in review."). Success toast "Lesson 4 submitted for approval." and the stepper moves; frozen lessons offer only **Withdraw** and History (UXP-3).
- Standards: `decideStandard` (CON-14) acts at once with a 6 s Undo toast (UXQ-8); `UNDO_EXPIRED` closes the toast and re-reads the lesson; `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` says "Couldn't reach the editor server. Nothing changed. Try again."
- Heartbeat sender (CON-20, HP-8): `sendHeartbeat` every 15 s only while the lesson is open, the tab in focus and touched within 60 s; reviewers and approvers only (authors never send); a failed heartbeat is dropped silently; pauses on hidden tab; no timer text shown beyond the disclosure.
- Must not: call a transition the role cannot use, compute time client-side beyond the cadence, or decide eligibility (the server decides; this is presentation of its reasons).

### Sources
- SCR-9 (signed) *Interactions*, *States* (Submit off with reasons, Server refuses Submit, Frozen, Withdrawn, Role-forbidden), *Copy fixed by the flows*; UXP-1, UXP-3, UXP-10, UXQ-8, UXQ-11
- CON-14 (agreed: `decideStandard` + `undo`, `UNDO_EXPIRED`, `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE`), CON-16 (agreed: `regenerateLesson`, `LESSON_LOCKED`, `DAY_CAP_REACHED`), CON-18 (agreed: transitions, error precedence), CON-20 (agreed: heartbeat cadence, author `ROLE_FORBIDDEN`); HP-5, HP-8, HP-10; PRD R-29, R-33, R-49, GR-15
- DO-3 §2.3 `src/features/workspace/actions/**`, §4 A14 row; NL-24 shells; NL-63's `onClientState` shape (cite DO-4 by name)

- `src/features/insert-quote/insert-quote-dialog.tsx` (replaces NL-24's shell, same props `InsertQuoteDialog({ lessonId, slotId, open, onClose })`) and its form parts: dialog `dialog-lg` over SCR-9; eyebrow with the address (`G6.U4.L4.LearningInAction.PartA`); title "Insert quote" or "Fill excerpt slot" by slot kind; a `well` quoting what the slot asks for; **Text** textarea with the counter "9 of 12 words" while rights are `short-quote-commentary`; **Source** (book, chapter, page; or URL for an excerpt); **Rights status** select (`short-quote-commentary`, `public-domain`, `licensed`, `to-clear`) with one-line help per option; Cancel · **Insert**.

The counter is a client hint only; the server's word rule decides. Success closes the dialog, toast "Quote inserted. Issue 1 resolved."; rights `to-clear`: "Inserted. Still blocking: rights to clear."
- Typed text kept through a re-sign-in on the same page via NL-24's `draft-memory.ts` (UXQ-1) and never written elsewhere before **Insert**. Insert is not offered on frozen lessons (the slot shows no button; NL-62 owns that rendering). Focus starts in Text; the counter announces only on crossing the limit.

### What to build
- `src/features/resolve/resolve-dialog.tsx` (replaces NL-24's shell, same props `ResolveDialog({ lessonId, mode: "resolve" | "clear_flag", issueId?, flagId?, open, onClose })`): dialog `dialog-sm`. *Resolve*: title "Record a resolution", the issue sentence in a `well`, **Reason (required)** textarea with the helper example, "Counted as a resolution, not a fix.", Cancel · **Record resolution** → `recordResolution`. *Clear flag*: title "Clear safety flag", the flag and the linked teacher tip quoted, **Note (required)**, "Your name, note and the time are logged and shown on the approver's checklist.", Cancel · **Clear flag** → `clearSafetyFlag`.

Rivera." / "Safety flag cleared."; the issue moves to the Resolved group (NL-62's rail re-reads).

frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);

### Story
US-22 — As a reviewer (P-1) I need a regenerated candidate shown beside the current lesson, section by section, so I can adopt the whole candidate, one section, or leave it, without losing the current lesson.

### What to build
- `app/(app)/units/[unitKey]/lessons/[lessonKey]/candidates/[candidate]/page.tsx` + `src/features/candidate/**`: breadcrumb "… › Lesson 4 › Candidate v4"; `h1` "Candidate v4 · not adopted" with meta (from the run's stored plan and pinned prompt, the note); two page sheets (current | candidate) aligned by section, each section row with **Adopt this section**; header **Adopt whole candidate** (primary) and **Leave unadopted** (ghost, back to SCR-9); under `lg` the sheets become tabs *Current · Candidate*; the note "Copying text by hand from the candidate is not tracked as an adoption." (HP-5 limit). `?section=` scrolls to a section.
- Data: `getCandidate` (CON-16), polled through `use-poll.ts` while drafting ("Drafting a candidate… The current lesson is unchanged." with the tile pill), `adoptCandidate` for whole or one section. Sections render through NL-62's read-view components (import, do not copy); all text as text (R-58).
- States: failed ("Candidate failed: Look Back is 3 minutes (needs 5). The current lesson is unchanged."); `DAY_CAP_REACHED` "Daily spend cap reached. No candidate was made."; `LESSON_LOCKED` "Lesson 4 is submitted. Withdraw it first to regenerate."; `INVALID_TRANSITION` reloads and shows the real state; `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` "Nothing changed. Try again."; partial (a section shows "Adopted by J. Rivera"); success toast "Look Back adopted from candidate v4. Logged as your edit." and return to SCR-9 with checks re-running; non-reviewers read only (no adopt controls, with "Only reviewers adopt candidates").
- Must not: merge text on the client, adopt a candidate that is not `ready`, or offer adoption on a frozen lesson. The client never edits the lesson; adoption is the server's single write (collab-applied).

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy

staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-25/US-27/US-31 — As an approver (P-3) I need to read one submitted lesson exactly as frozen, check each checklist item against its evidence, rate the draft, and approve that pinned version, one lesson at a time.

### What to build
- `app/(app)/units/[unitKey]/lessons/[lessonKey]/approve/page.tsx` + `src/features/approval/**`: breadcrumb *Unit 4 › Approvals › Lesson 5*; stepper on step 3; eyebrow "Approval review"; meta with the pin icon and the snapshot hash `9f3c…a21e`; dependency banner ("Lesson 4 is waiting on this lesson's excerpt."); the **Checklist** (4–6 items, each with a check/blocking glyph, bold title, evidence line and a link that jumps to its span in the frozen text) from `getLesson` (CON-11 checklist and snapshot) and `getLessonIssues` (CON-13 re-checked); **Lesson text (frozen at `9f3c…a21e`)** through NL-62's read-view components. Checklist items load before the frozen text (skeleton for the text).
- Decision rail: four-eyes banner (`success` "Four eyes · You did not edit this lesson, so you can approve it." / `warn` "Someone else must approve: you were the last editor of this lesson (including AI accepts and adopted candidates)."), the `fieldset` with `legend` "Draft quality (required)" and radio cards (Usable as drafted · Usable with edits · Rewritten), **Approve this version** (primary `lg`, `aria-disabled` with its reason), **Request changes** (secondary `lg`, opens SCR-15 / NL-69), and the pin small print. Approve sends `transitionLesson` with the pinned hash and state vector and the rating.
- Errors as spec: `STALE_PIN` 409 → `role="alert"` banner "This lesson changed since you opened it. Reload." with **Reload**, focus on it, the decision card off until reload; `RATING_REQUIRED` → "Choose a rating to approve." and focus on the first radio; `FOUR_EYES`; `DEPENDENCY_UNAPPROVED` ("Homework text — Lesson 5 must be approved first" with a link; Approve off with that reason); `BLOCKED` ("Approve refused: `RL.6.2` has no checking item.", the item flips to blocking); network ("Couldn't reach the server. Your rating is kept. Try again."). Not submitted: "Lesson 4 isn't submitted yet. It's in review with M. Okafor." with a read-only link and no decision card.
- Success: `success` banner "Approved by D. Park · pinned `9f3c…a21e` · Usable with edits", stepper step 4, toast "Lesson 5 approved." and, if a lesson waits on it, "Lesson 4 can now be approved."; `approved`/`exported` replace the card with "Approved by D. Park on 2026-10-25" and **Reopen…** (SCR-15). Reviewer/author: everything readable, the card says "Only approvers can approve". Heartbeats (CON-20) use NL-64's hook; no bulk control exists.
- Must not: approve without the pin, hide the rating requirement, compute eligibility client-side beyond presenting the server's reasons, or offer any multi-lesson action (GR-6).

### Sources

- DO-3 §2.3, §4 A14 row; NL-62 read-view components; NL-24 client
- **Brief check:** serves "Have a UI/UX for approval workflow for lessons within a unit, where once reviewed/updated it is flagged as complete in our system."; touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

- `src/features/send-back/send-back-dialog.tsx` (replaces NL-24's shell, same props `SendBackDialog({ lessonId, mode: "request_changes" | "reopen", pin, open, onClose })`): dialog `dialog-md` over SCR-14. *Request changes*: title "Request changes to Lesson 5"; **Reason** tag as a `fieldset` radio group with `legend` "Reason" (Standards · Quotes and rights · ELD support · Content safety · AI spans · Teaching quality · Other; UXP-6); **Note** (required); "J. Rivera will see your tag and note on the board and in the lesson."; Cancel · **Send back**. *Reopen*: title "Reopen Lesson 5"; **Reason** (required); a `warn` banner when lessons depend on it ("Lesson 4 links to this lesson. It will be flagged and held back from export until Lesson 5 is approved again.", dependants from the lesson read); Cancel · **Reopen** (makes a new version).
- Calls `transitionLesson` (CON-18) with `request_changes {tag, note, pin}` or `reopen {reason, pin}`. Errors: `NOTE_REQUIRED` "Add a note: say what needs to change."; `REASON_REQUIRED` on Reopen; `STALE_PIN` closes the dialog to the SCR-14 banner "This lesson changed since you opened it. Reload."; `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` and network keep the text with "Try again."; `INVALID_TRANSITION` reloads the lesson. Success toasts "Sent back to J. Rivera." / "Lesson 5 reopened as version 3."
- Focus starts on the tag group (request changes) or the Reason field (reopen); typed text survives a re-sign-in (UXQ-1). Only approvers see the openers (NL-68 renders them); a forbidden call shows the server sentence.
- Must not: send without the pin, default a tag silently, or hide the dependants warning.

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
US-23 — As a reviewer (P-1) I need to rewrite a selected passage from my note as a suggestion I accept or reject, so AI help is visible, optional and never silent (cut #8: the whole panel can be dropped).

### What to build
- `src/features/assist/assist-panel.tsx` (replaces NL-24's shell, same props `AssistPanel({ lessonId, selection, onClose })`): a panel that replaces the rail's content while open — title "Rewrite selection", a back arrow to the rail, the selected text quoted, **My note**, a `warn` line "Don't paste student work.", **Ask for a suggestion** (secondary, never a sparkle), and the suggestion card (look-sheet anatomy `d1-05`): the rewrite, **Accept** (primary) and **Reject**. `requestSuggestion` then `decideSuggestion` (CON-17); `listSuggestions` restores a pending suggestion after a reload.
- States: while pending, the panel tells NL-64's bar via the shared `clientState` channel so Submit and Approve show "Accept or reject the AI suggestion first"; `ANCHOR_CHANGED` "Text changed, ask again."; `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` "Couldn't get a suggestion. Nothing changed."; `LESSON_LOCKED`/frozen: not offered; `INVALID_TRANSITION` re-reads; `COLLAB_UNAVAILABLE` leaves the suggestion pending with a retry; accepted: toast "Applied as your edit (AI-assisted)."; rejected: "Discarded."
- Cut #8: the panel is reachable only through the More-menu entry NL-64 shows when NL-24's nav/cut flag stands; with the flag off nothing here is reachable and the build still passes.

### Story
US-10 — As an outline author (P-2) I need to edit the guidance layer of the prompt as numbered versions with a reason, and try it on one lesson, so I can tweak the output without touching the locked rules (cut #7).

Right: the selected version's text with a diff against the previous one; the **locked layer** shown read-only with the label "Locked rules (read-only)" and no edit control; the guidance editor (plain textarea, text only) with a required **Reason** and **Save as new version**; **Try on one lesson** (select a lesson, then a candidate is made and the person lands on SCR-12).

Success "Guidance v2 saved. Runs already going keep v1."; trial "Candidate made on Lesson 4, not adopted."; `REASON_REQUIRED` "A version needs a reason."; `STALE_BASE` shows the newer version with its diff and keeps the typed text; `ROLE_FORBIDDEN` read-only for non-authors with "Only authors edit guidance."; can't-load shared message; typed text survives re-sign-in (UXQ-1).
- Cut #7: reachable only while NL-24's nav flag for #7 stands; with it off the route is not-found and NL-55's ghost link is hidden.
- Must not: render the locked layer in an editable control, send the locked layer text in any request, or render guidance as HTML.
