## [NL-142] delivery: retro and lessons fed back (proposals for principles and zero-to-hero)

_Conventions for every Newsela Lesson Studio issue:_ repo `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` (VPS working copy
`/home/linuxuser/workspaces/inno-newsela`); read `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/README.md`, `.claude/reference/area-map.md`
and `docs/plans/HANDOFF-PHASE-B.md` first; vocabulary from `docs/design/component-contracts.md` (DO-4) and
`docs/contracts/INTERFACE.md`. Build-loop tickets go plan → implement → test → review (`.claude/rules/build-loop-test-scope.md`;
frozen tests first only for `risk::security`); only affected tests run. Never: quote or read `docs/source/restricted/`
into code, prompts, fixtures or issues (GR-9); copy a provider key (use `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/bin/with-provider-env`);
restate or contradict an agreed `CON-N` (changes go through `docs/contracts/CHANGES.md` as `CHG-N`); use real student or
staff data (synthetic, seeded, traceable). Evidence is a command and its output, attached to the issue.

### Story
Delivery (no US) — the zero-to-hero retro habit (Equinox, 2026-10-14) is how the next project starts better. This project tried new things (a two-phase VPS run, Sonnet-written specs, per-ticket readiness, light-mode zero-to-hero 2.0.0); the record of what worked and what did not should reach the shared rules while it is fresh.

### What to build
Write `docs/delivery/<YYYY-MM-DD>-retro.md` from the record (`docs/devlog/`, the ledger, the reports, `ops/vps-run/` logs, the decision tables), not from memory.

Sections: (1) **What we built vs. what the plan said** (tickets done / cut / added; the critical path as it actually ran). (2) **Numbers**: wall time per phase, Claude Code spend vs PD-35 budgets, model spend vs PD-29, tickets per wave, bisect and send-back counts, token cost of planning vs implementing (the context-pack rule's effect, if measurable). (3) **What worked** (each with evidence). (4) **What went wrong or cost more than it should** (each with the dev-log line). (5) **Proposals**: each is a numbered change with *target file* (the original in `Nortorious-Technologies/.claude/rules/…` or `skills/zero-to-hero/…`, named, not edited), the observed failure it answers, the proposed wording in two or three lines, and the evidence. **Proposals are not applied here:** the originals change only on Innocent's yes (`context-maintenance.md` rule 8: change the original first, then re-copy). (6) **Open questions for Innocent.**

Lane guard (`ticket-lanes`): this ticket edits only the retro file (and the dev log). Lane guard (`ticket-lanes`): before committing, `git diff --name-only` must list no file that code or tests read (source, tests, schemas, migrations, prompts, settings, lockfiles, fixtures, CI); if it does, stop, relabel the ticket `lane::build-loop` and report. Commit straight to `main` (factory mode, PD-34).

### Sources
- `docs/devlog/`, `docs/prd/newsela-prd.md` (PD-32…PD-35), `ops/vps-run/` (launcher logs), `docs/plans/slice-plan.md` and the build ledger; the reports
- Shared originals to propose against: `/home/linuxuser/workspaces/.claude/rules/` and `.claude/skills/zero-to-hero/`; `.claude/rules/context-maintenance.md` rule 8
- **Brief check:** not a brief deliverable (internal retro); touches nothing out of scope; weakens nothing → proceed.

- [ ] AC-1 [invariant] the retro has the six sections and every claim cites a source path — verify: `grep -nE '^## ' docs/delivery/*-retro.md` and a path-exists loop — evidence: six headings in order; no `MISSING` path — covers: —
- [ ] AC-2 [invariant] the numbers section states measured spend and time against PD-29 / PD-35 with sources, or says not recorded — verify: `grep -nE '\$[0-9]|[0-9]+ ?(h|min)' docs/delivery/*-retro.md` — evidence: each hit cites a log or report; a missing figure is stated as missing — covers: GR-14
- [ ] AC-3 [invariant] each proposal names its target file, the failure it answers and the evidence, and none is applied — verify: read of *Proposals* and `git diff --name-only` — evidence: ≥ 1 numbered proposal with target, failure, wording, evidence; the diff touches no file outside this repo's delivery folder and dev log — covers: —
- [ ] AC-4 [negative] no key, restricted content or personal data in the retro — verify: `grep -niE 'sk-ant-|sk-or-|restricted/originals' docs/delivery/*-retro.md` — evidence: no match — covers: GR-9, OBS-7
- [ ] AC-5 [regression/context] router row for the retro planned → exists; dev-log entry; `.claude/state/resume.md` — verify: `git diff --name-only` — evidence: only the retro file, `.claude/README.md`, the dev-log file and `.claude/state/resume.md`

### Story
Delivery (no US) — the brief says "Submit directly from this page. Your submission is tied to this project version." Only Innocent can submit under his account. Due Tue 2026-10-27 03:00 CT (SUBMISSION.md; if he meant Monday 2026-10-26 03:00, the margin is a day shorter).

### What to build
**What Innocent does (`gate::human`).** About 15 minutes, after NL-141 says every row is walked.
1. **Check the three open points on the top of `SUBMISSION.md`:** (a) the source repo link: can a reviewer open it? The GitLab project `innocentnortey/inno-newsela` is **private**; making it visible, adding a reviewer account or giving a different link is **his decision**, and Claude changes no visibility; (b) the demo video URL plays without signing in; (c) the technical contact (andrew.parker@newsela.com) is **not** emailed unless he says so.
2. **On the Gauntlet portal project page** ("Submit this project"): add the deliverables as the page asks: Source Code (repo link at the `release-<sha>` tag), Technical Documentation (`README.md` and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` in the repo), Demo Video (the URL), and the AI Usage Documentation (`docs/AI-USAGE.md`) if the page has a place for it. Use the same SHA everywhere.
3. **Submit**, then reply on the issue with the confirmation text or a screenshot (his own screen; Claude cannot reach the portal).
4. Reply "submitted" with the time. If anything on the page differs from `SUBMISSION.md`, say what.

**What Claude records afterwards.** `SUBMISSION.md` header: submitted at (his time, CT), the SHA, the confirmation text he pasted (labelled human-only); the dev-log entry; `.claude/state/resume.md` set to "submitted; maintenance only". Claude never logs in to the portal, never submits for him, and does not push to any other remote.
